### 3.3.8.457 CVIS-472 The String Output Tool is not trained.

Cause: The String Output Tool has not been properly configured.

Remedy: Open the setup page for the String Output Tool. Select a valid tool name and string measurement name.

### 3.3.8.458 CVIS-473 Invalid model ID is specified.

Cause: Invalid model ID is specified.

Remedy: Specify the model ID for that you want to change a load balance.

<!-- PDF page 325 -->

### 3.3.8.459 CVIS-474 Specified load balance is over range.

Cause: Specified load balance is over range.

Remedy: Specify load balance in range.

### 3.3.8.460 CVIS-475 Specified parameter is not supported.

Cause: Specified parameter is not supported.

Remedy: Specify supported parameter.

### 3.3.8.461 CVIS-476 RUN FIND failed

Cause: Vision Find failed

Remedy: Look at previous CVIS error for remedy

### 3.3.8.462 CVIS-477 Invalid Number of tools for Gun

Cause: Tool Number must be 1 or 2

Remedy: Use SETUP>GUN to reset number of tools.

### 3.3.8.463 CVIS-478 GET OFFSET wrong model ID

Cause: GET OFFSET Not all model IDs found at View 1 for 1st wire

Remedy: Make sure that the vision process edge point tool's search window includes only the wire. There may not be enough points on the wire.

### 3.3.8.464 CVIS-479 GET OFFSET VP 2 Wire 1:Not all model IDs found

Cause: GET OFFSET Not all model IDs found at View 2 for 1st wire.

Remedy: Make sure the Search window includes the wire and only the wire in the window. At least ten points on the wire must be found.

### 3.3.8.465 CVIS-480 GET OFFSET VP 1 Wire 2:Not all model IDs found

Cause: The second wire was not found by vision at the first view position.

<!-- PDF page 326 -->

**Remedy:** Make sure both wires are in the search window and that at least ten points are found on each wire.

### 3.3.8.466 CVIS-481 GET OFFSET VP 2 Wire 2:Not all model IDs found

**Cause:** The 2nd wire was not found in the second view.

**Remedy:** Make sure the VP search window encloses both wires and only the wires. There must be at least ten points on each wire.

### 3.3.8.467 CVIS-482 GET OFFSET Invalid Number of tools

**Cause:** The number of tools per gun must be one or two.

**Remedy:** Use SETUP>Guns to set the number of tools to one or two.

### 3.3.8.468 CVIS-483 Wire1:Two views are parallel

**Cause:** The Two view positions are the same.

**Remedy:** Make sure that view 1 and view 2 differ in yaw, normally it is a 90 degree difference in yaw. This error can be caused by using the same position for view 1 and view 2. This is respect to the application frame. Note a change in application frame yaw is seen as a change in roll with respect to the UTOOL.

### 3.3.8.469 CVIS-484 Wire2:Two views are parallel

**Cause:** The two robot views are nearly the same position.

**Remedy:** Adjust one of the view positions by rotating the tool. View 2 should be rotated about 90 degrees from view 1.

### 3.3.8.470 CVIS-485 Tool Z End or Base cannot be 0

**Cause:** The Z axis is defined to be dominant. Therefore the base and end model IDs must both be non zero

**Remedy:** Use SETUP>TOOLS to define the base Z and end Z to be non zero. MOst weld guns can be easily defined by selecting the Single or Dual choice using the SET TOOL function key.

<!-- PDF page 327 -->

### 3.3.8.471 CVIS-486 Tool X End or Base cannot be 0

Cause: The X axis is the dominant axis. The Base X and End X model IDs cannot be zero.

Remedy: Use SETUP>TOOL to define the Base X and End X model IDs. The standard tool definitions can be reset using the SET TOOL function key and selecting Single or Dual.

### 3.3.8.472 CVIS-487 Element exceeds Warning threshold

Cause: Multiple consecutive warnings on automatic retry have occurred without success. Once the retry threshold has been exceeded, an error is posted

Remedy: Determine what is causing the previous alarm log warnings and fix the problem. Chose RETRY to repeat the retry. Choose Continue to ignore the error. The UTOOL is not updated when this error is posted.

### 3.3.8.473 CVIS-488 Element exceeds Error threshold

Cause: The element (X, Y, Z, W, P, or R) has exceeded the error threshold for change in the UTOOL.

Remedy: The tool or the wire has deviated more than the allowable error threshold values. This is a safety check to make sure the calculated UTOOL is reasonable or to find a badly mangle tool. The user should straighten the torch or wire and repeat the test.

### 3.3.8.474 CVIS-489 Get Focal Point Failed

Cause: The irtUtility program for getting the focal point has failed. The same error can occur using the FLAG screen to get the focal point position.

Remedy: The usual cause is an invalid vision process name or an invalid camera calibration name in the vision process. Also verify that the camera calibration is a fixed camera calibration.

### 3.3.8.475 CVIS-490 Model 1 and Model 3 same point

Cause: The top of the wire #1 and the bottom of wire #1 are too close (same point).

Remedy: This is probably cause by not enough wire in the search window. Change the search window so that it includes more wire. The other possibility is that the wire is too short. The wire must have at least 1.0 mm in the search window.

<!-- PDF page 328 -->

### 3.3.8.476 CVIS-491 Model 4 and Model 6 same point

Cause: Wire 2 top and bottom point are the same point or within 1.0 mm.

Remedy: The vision process search window may be too small and chopping off part of the wire. The wire may be too short. At least 1.0 mm must be in the vision process search window.

### 3.3.8.477 CVIS-492 6th parameter not Gun No

Cause: The call to irtmain requires a sixth parameter for this function. The parameter is a gun number.

Remedy: Change or add a sixth parameter. The gun number should be 1, 2, 3, or 4.

### 3.3.8.478 CVIS-493 6th parameter not Tool No

Cause: The call to irtmain requires a sixth parameter for this function. The parameter is a tool number.

Remedy: Change or add a sixth parameter. The tool number should be 1 or 2.

### 3.3.8.479 CVIS-494 2nd parameter not VP Name

Cause: The call to irtmain requires a second parameter for this function. The parameter is the vision process name.

Remedy: Change or add a second parameter. The vision process name should be 'irtwire_g1' for a group 1 robot.

### 3.3.8.480 CVIS-495 6th parameter not View No

Cause: The call to irtmain requires a sixth parameter for this function. The parameter is the view number.

Remedy: Change or add a sixth parameter. The view number should be 1 or 2.

### 3.3.8.481 CVIS-496 4th parameter not PR index

Cause: The call to irtmain requires a fourth parameter for this function. The parameter is a position register index.

Remedy: Change or add a fourth parameter. The position register index should be 1 to the maximum number of position registers. (usually 100)

<!-- PDF page 329 -->

### 3.3.8.482 CVIS-497 Focal point is not initialized

Cause: The focal point has not been calculated for irtmain.

Remedy: Use the irtUtility TP program to perform the Get Focal function. The user may also use the SETUP>FLAGS screen to enable the GET FOCAL check box. The check box clears when finished. The TP status line display every tenth line number. The number of line may exceed 8000.

### 3.3.8.483 CVIS-498 Focal point is NILPOS

Cause: The focal point has not been calculated for irtmain.

Remedy: Use the irtUtility TP program to perform the Get Focal function. The user may also use the SETUP>FLAGS screen to enable the GET FOCAL check box. The check box clears when finished. The TP status line display every tenth line number. The number of line may exceed 8000.

### 3.3.8.484 CVIS-499 3rd parameter not Status Register

Cause: The call to irtmain requires a second parameter for this function. The parameter is the status register index.

Remedy: Change or add a second parameter. The status register index can be any value register number (1 to 200).

### 3.3.8.485 CVIS-500 6th parameter not Group No

Cause: The call to irtmain requires a sixth parameter for this function. The parameter is the group number.

Remedy: Change or add a sixth parameter. The group number should be 1 through 4

### 3.3.8.486 CVIS-501 SET_INT_REG failed

Cause: Failed to set the status register containing the return code

Remedy: Make sure the second parameter is a valid register index

### 3.3.8.487 CVIS-502 Num. consecutive warnings exceeds threshold

Cause: The maximum number of consecutive warnings has been exceeded and an error to this effect has been posted.

<!-- PDF page 330 -->

Remedy: IrTorchMate automatically retries warnings the maximum retry count. If there is no success, this error is posted. The operator should look at the previous alarms to determine the problem. Slect retry after the problem has been fixed.

### 3.3.8.488 CVIS-503 Operator Response : ABORT

Cause: The operator has selected the ABORT recovery option

Remedy: none

### 3.3.8.489 CVIS-504 Operator Response : IGNORE

Cause: The operator has selected the IGNORE recovery option

Remedy: none

### 3.3.8.490 CVIS-505 Operator Response : RETRY

Cause: The operator has selected the RETRY recovery option

Remedy: none

### 3.3.8.491 CVIS-506 Posture W and P can not be calcurated.

Cause: Posture W and P can not be calcurated.

Remedy: Enable aspect in GPM locator tool of robot-generated grid calibration.

### 3.3.8.492 CVIS-507 Move area is limited in the measurement of robot-generated grid calibration.

Cause: Move area is limited in the measurement of robot-generated grid calibration.

Remedy: Make sure to check accuracy of measured results.

### 3.3.8.493 CVIS-508 Calibration data is not selected.

Cause: Calibration data is not selected.

Remedy: Select calibration data.

<!-- PDF page 331 -->

### 3.3.8.494 CVIS-509 One or more targets were not found.

Cause: One or more non-required targets were not found. The 3-D offset was computed

Remedy: Check the vision log to investigate whether the part was wrong or damaged.

### 3.3.8.495 CVIS-510 No vision offset server was found.

Cause: No vision offset server could be found on the RIPE network. Either there are no robots has_vision variable set to TRUE.

Remedy: Make sure that this robot and the vision server have RIPE set up, that they both have to TRUE.

### 3.3.8.496 CVIS-511 Limit Check: %s

Cause: The vision result has failed one or more parameters set in the configured Limit Check tool.

Remedy: Adjust the parameters, or adjust the target.

### 3.3.8.497 CVIS-512 %s is directory

Cause: Directory is not supported.

Remedy: Specify file.

### 3.3.8.498 CVIS-513 Log is on process to export

Cause: Log is on process to export.

Remedy: Wait for completion of process to export

### 3.3.8.499 CVIS-514 RUN_FIND_OFFSET failed

Cause: The RUNOFFST program had a vision error in GET_OFFSET.

Remedy: Adjust part, check lighting, clean camera lens, adjust camera parameters, reteach camera setup.

<!-- PDF page 332 -->

### 3.3.8.500 CVIS-515 Camera is not connected

Cause: Camera is not connected.

Remedy: Connect a camera.

### 3.3.8.501 CVIS-516 The 2-D Barcode reader does not support QR Code Model 1.

Cause: The 2-D Barcode is QR Code Model 1. This code is is old and is not supported.

Remedy: None.

### 3.3.8.502 CVIS-517 Error Proof Failed

Cause: The RUNPASSF program had a vision error in GET_PASSFAIL

Remedy: Adjust part, check lighting, clean camera lens, adjust camera parameters, reteach camera setup.

### 3.3.8.503 CVIS-518 Error Proof Inconclusive

Cause: The RUNPASSF program had a vision error in GET_PASSFAIL.

Remedy: The Parent part was not found. Test is inconclusive.

### 3.3.8.504 CVIS-519 Operator Selected Custom Recovery

Cause: The operator has selected a custom recovery option after a vision error.

Remedy: None this is a log of how an error was handled.

### 3.3.8.505 CVIS-520 Operator Retried Operation

Cause: The operator has Retried the process after a vision error.

Remedy: None this is a log of how an error was handled.

### 3.3.8.506 CVIS-521 Operator Ignored Operation

Cause: The operator has Ignore the vision error.

<!-- PDF page 333 -->

Remedy: None this is a log of how an error was handled.

### 3.3.8.507 CVIS-522 Failed to detect motion.

Cause: Motion of axis failed to be detected.

Remedy: Check measuring group number are same as selected group number on uif. Check measuring axis number are same as selected axis number on uif.

### 3.3.8.508 CVIS-523 Failed to align to ref. pos.

Cause: Target mark can't be aligned to reference position.

Remedy: Check measuring group number are same as selected group number on uif. Check measuring axis number are same as selected axis number on uif. Check attachment of measuring target mark again.

### 3.3.8.509 CVIS-524 Robot position is invalid.

Cause: Robot position is invalid.

Remedy: Reteach the position and try the operation again.

### 3.3.8.510 CVIS-525 Master image is not trained

Cause: Master image is not trained.

Remedy: Train master image first.

### 3.3.8.511 CVIS-526 Wrong master image size

Cause: The size of image to add does not coincide with the size of master image.

Remedy: Either capture or load an image with the size of master image, or clear the master image first.

### 3.3.8.512 CVIS-527 Master image reference pose is not set

Cause: Window Shift Tool is inserted before Surface Flaw Inspection Tool.

Remedy: Train master image for static removal again.

<!-- PDF page 334 -->

### 3.3.8.513 CVIS-528 Shading coefficients are not set

Cause: Shading coefficients are not set.

Remedy: Train master image for shading removal first.

### 3.3.8.514 CVIS-529 Shading coefficients cannot be calculated

Cause: Not enough pixels are available to calculate the shading coefficients.

Remedy: Re-edit the run-time mask for shading background removal and reduce the area to mask.

### 3.3.8.515 CVIS-530 Image is not suitable for teaching shading removal

Cause: The image is not suitable for teaching shading removal.

Remedy: Use another image preprocess, or mask the pixels that have irrelevant grayscale change.

### 3.3.8.516 CVIS-531 Buffer is full.

Cause: Internal error

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.517 CVIS-532 Vision data is too big.

Cause: Vision data is too big to handle.

Remedy: Make the vision data smaller.

### 3.3.8.518 CVIS-533 Cannot remove this tool.

Cause: The command tool cannot be removed.

Remedy: None.

### 3.3.8.519 CVIS-534 This camera is not color camera.

Cause: A grayscale camera is used for color image operation.

<!-- PDF page 335 -->

Remedy: Use a color camera.

### 3.3.8.520 CVIS-535 Multi-Exposure cannot be used with color camera.

Cause: Multi-exposure function cannot be used with a color camera.

Remedy: Use it in the single exposure mode.

### 3.3.8.521 CVIS-536 Auto-Exposure cannot be used with color camera.

Cause: Auto exposure function cannot be used with a color camera.

Remedy: Use it in the fixed exposure mode.

### 3.3.8.522 CVIS-537 Cannot find specified tool.

Cause: The tool specified as the input image is not found in the vision process.

Remedy: Select a proper tool, or add an image filter tool.

### 3.3.8.523 CVIS-538 Image Filter tool is not trained.

Cause: The Image Filter tool is not trained.

Remedy: Train the Image Filter tool.

### 3.3.8.524 CVIS-539 Color Extract tool is not trained.

Cause: Color Extract tool is not trained.

Remedy: Train Color Extract tool

Cause: Specified work area is too narrow.

Remedy: Set up proper boundaries of work area.

Cause: Internal Error

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.527 CVIS-542 Robot cannot move to the destination

Cause: Internal Error

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

Cause: Internal Error

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.529 CVIS-545 This operation is not allowed during production.

Cause: This operation is not allowed in production.

Remedy: Please enable TP or change mode to T1 or T2.

### 3.3.8.530 CVIS-546 Internal error. %s

Cause: In Bin Picking, an internal error has occurred.

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.531 CVIS-547 No argument. %s

Cause: In Bin Picking, a KAREL program has been executed with an argument missing.

Remedy: Please enter the correct argument.

<!-- PDF page 337 -->

### 3.3.8.532 CVIS-548 Bad argument. %s

Cause: In Bin Picking, a KAREL program has been executed with an argument invalid.

Remedy: Please enter the correct argument.

### 3.3.8.533 CVIS-549 No Parts List. %s

Cause: In Bin Picking, the Parts List ID specified as an argument of a KAREL program does not exist.

Remedy: Please enter the correct Parts List ID.

### 3.3.8.534 CVIS-550 No Part Data. %s

Cause: In Bin Picking, Part Data which has been popped by IMPOP.PC or is specified as an argument does not exist. In the case that no Part Data is specified, IMPOP.PC has not been executed or the popped Part Data has been deleted. In the other case, the specified Part ID is invalid or the Part Data has been deleted.

Remedy: Please confirm the TP program to enter correct Part Data ID.

### 3.3.8.535 CVIS-551 Not trained. %s

Cause: In Bin Picking, the Parts List Manager's setup referred by a KAREL program is not trained.

Remedy: Please complete the setup.

### 3.3.8.536 CVIS-552 The setup is invalid. Please set FINE Position ID and FINE VP correctly.

Cause: In Bin Picking, FINE vision process and FINE position refers each other in a circle.

Remedy: Please set FINE Position ID and FINE VP correctly.

### 3.3.8.537 CVIS-553 Wizard process has timed out.

Cause: In Bin Picking, a wizard process has timed out.

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

<!-- PDF page 338 -->

# **3.3.8.538 CVIS-554 Bad PR type. %s**

**Cause:** In Bin Picking, the type of a Position Register which has been referred by a KAREL program is invalid.

**Remedy:** Please make the type Cartesian.

# **3.3.8.539 CVIS-555 Uninitialized PR. %s**

**Cause:** In Bin Picking, a Position Register which has been referred by a KAREL program is not initialized.

**Remedy:** Please initialize the Position Register.

# **3.3.8.540 CVIS-556 Model ID does not match between FIND and Setup. %s**

**Cause:** In Bin Picking, the Model ID of Part Data does not corresponds with that of the setup.

**Remedy:** Please correct the Part ID or the setup.

# **3.3.8.541 CVIS-557 Vision process does not match between FIND and Setup. %s**

**Cause:** In Bin Picking, the vision process of Part Data does not corresponds with that of the setup.

**Remedy:** Please correct the Part ID or the setup.

# **3.3.8.542 CVIS-558 Snap Retry Occurs%s**

**Cause:** Snap Retry Occurs.

**Remedy:** Please check the Camera and Cables.

# **3.3.8.543 CVIS-559 There is no suitable candidate from the tilt of the Z-axis.**

**Cause:** In Interference Avoidance, there is no suitable candidate because of the tilt of the Z-axis.

**Remedy:** This alarm does not mean a serious problem. If it persists, please tune 'Angle Between Z-axis And Pos' or correct Reference Position.

<!-- PDF page 339 -->

### 3.3.8.544 CVIS-560 Another Camera is running

Cause: Another Camera is running.

Remedy: Please don't use Analog Camera when Digital Camera is running.

### 3.3.8.545 CVIS-561 Taught vertices are too near

Cause: Taught vertices are too near.

Remedy: Reteach vertex.

### 3.3.8.546 CVIS-562 All taught vertices are on a same line.

Cause: All taught vertices are on a same line.

Remedy: Reteach vertex.

Cause: Inspection interval is too long with respect to bead line.

Remedy: Change inspection interval or reteach vertex.

### 3.3.8.548 CVIS-564 3D map write error

Cause: This is an alarm of 3D Area Sensor. The buffer to store 3D map was reserved for writing. This alarm can occur when run-time process and-setup time process tried to acquire 3D map at the same time.

Remedy: Don't try to acquire 3D map on the setup page during production.

Cause: Projector unit is already controlled.

Remedy: Make sure not to control projector unit at a same time.

Cause: Projector setting is not correct.

<!-- PDF page 340 -->

Remedy: Correct projector settings.

### 3.3.8.551 CVIS-567 Projector control error

Cause: Projector control error

Remedy: Check projector settings.

### 3.3.8.552 CVIS-568 3D map buffer is not found

Cause: 3D map buffer is not found.

Remedy: Set number of 3D map buffer.

### 3.3.8.553 CVIS-569 Intersect point calculation error

Cause: Internal error.

### 3.3.8.554 CVIS-570 Subpixel calculation error

Cause: Internal error.

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

Cause: Projector temperature error

Cause: Projector fan error

Remedy: Change projector unit.

Cause: All cameras are not calibrated based on same UF.

Remedy: Calibrate all camera based on same UF.

### 3.3.8.561 CVIS-577 Projector communication error.

Cause: Projector communication error.

Remedy: Check cables.

### 3.3.8.562 CVIS-578 Camera layout error.

Cause: Camera layout is wrong. Or same camera cannot select.

### 3.3.8.563 CVIS-579 3D map buffer time out

Cause: 3D map buffer time out

Remedy: None.

### 3.3.8.564 CVIS-580 Unsupported 3D map file

Cause: Unsupported 3D map file

### 3.3.8.565 CVIS-581 Wait for cooling down projector %d ms

### 3.3.8.566 CVIS-582 Invalid image size

Cause: Invalid image size is selected in camera setup.

Remedy: Select valid image size.

### 3.3.8.567 CVIS-583 Projector version error.

Cause: This is an alarm of 3D Area Sensor. The firmware version of the projector unit is too old.

Remedy: Document the events that led to the error and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

### 3.3.8.568 CVIS-584 The dimension of Ref. Pos is invalid.

Cause: The dimension of Ref. Pos is invalid because the setup of window shift tool has been changed.

Remedy: Teach container shape.

### 3.3.8.569 CVIS-585 Window shift tool doesn't have 3D result.

Cause: Window shift tool doesn't have 3d result.

Remedy: Use the result of vision register in window shift tool.

### 3.3.8.570 CVIS-586 The size of log image is wrong.

Cause: The size of log image is wrong.

<!-- PDF page 343 -->

Remedy: Confirm that the size of log image and the setting of [Use Shrink Image] on the Area Sensor Vision Process setup page are set correctly.

### 3.3.8.571 CVIS-587 No 3D Map Mask.

Cause: Area Sensor Preprocess Tool does not have 3D Map Mask.

Remedy: Train Area Sensor Preprocess Tool or select proper Area Sensor Preprocess Tool.

### 3.3.8.572 CVIS-588 Not enough 3D points for calculation.

Cause: The number of 3D points in the measurement area is less than the threshold. There may be the following causes. 1. The position or size of the measurement area is not appropriate. 2. The 3D Map is sparse. 3. The threshold of the number of 3D points is not appropriate.

Remedy: Depending on the causes, adjust or re-teach the following items. 1. [Measurement Area] and [Window Mask] 2. The settings of 3D Area Sensor. 3. [Min Num. Valid Points].

### 3.3.8.573 CVIS-589 Suitable plane for 3D Map is not found.

Cause: No plane was found during plane measurement. There may be the following causes. 1. The position or size of the measurement area is not appropriate. 2. The 3D Map is sparse. 3. The set of 3D points in the measurement area is not suitable for the model to fit

Remedy: Depending on the causes, adjust or re-teach the following items. 1. [Measurement Area] and [Window Mask] 2. The settings of 3D Area Sensor. 3. [Min Num. Valid Points] and [Fit Error Threshold].

### 3.3.8.574 CVIS-590 Center of gravity of 3D Map cannot be calculated.

Cause: Valid 3D points in the measurement area did not converge at one point. There may be the following causes. 1. The height of a part of a workpiece differs largely from that of another part within the measurement area or the position or size of the measurement area is not appropriate. 2. The range where valid 3D points belong is not appropriate. 3. Parameters to acquire the 3D Map are inappropriate or the calibration data is incorrect.

Remedy: Depending on the causes, adjust or re-teach the following items. 1. [Measurement Area] and [Window Mask]. 2. [Z Range]. 3. The settings of 3D Area Sensor or the setting of camera calibration.

### 3.3.8.575 CVIS-591 USB Camera isn't connected.

Cause: USB camera isn't connected to iPendant.

<!-- PDF page 344 -->

Remedy: Connect USB camera to iPendant.

Cause: USB camera system error happens.

Remedy: Please tell the last number of this error to FANUC.

Cause: The size of model is too large with respect to search window.

### 3.3.8.580 CVIS-596 Target is not found

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.581 CVIS-597 When offset type is tool offset, window shift tool can't use other VP Result.

Cause: Offset type is tool offset on the vision process or the vision register.

Remedy: Change the offset type to fixed frame offset.

<!-- PDF page 345 -->

### 3.3.8.582 CVIS-598 When robot-mounted camera is used, window shift tool can't use other VP Result.

Cause: When robot-mounted camera is used, window shift tool can't use other VP result.

Remedy: Select locator tool for mode on window shift tool, or use fixed camera.

### 3.3.8.583 CVIS-599 Frame number is different on vision process and vision register.

Cause: Frame number is different on vision process and vision register.

Remedy: Select a same offset frame number on two vision process, one is what has window shift tool, and the other is for window shift.

### 3.3.8.584 CVIS-600 Because of the soft update, window shift tool must be taught again.

Cause: Because of the soft update, window shift tool must be taught again.

Remedy: Do the following operation. VP1 is the vision process that has the window shift tool, and VP2 is the vision process that makes the result for the window shift. 1. On VP2, select the same number of Offset Frame as VP1. At this time, reset the reference data. 2. Setup the reference data again. 3. RUN_FIND and GET_OFFSET VP2 to set the result on the vision register. 4. Open VP1, and re-teach search window or measurement area of all the command tools VP1 has.

### 3.3.8.585 CVIS-601 Camera type has been changed after teaching model.

Cause: The type of the camera has been changed after teaching model.

Remedy: Reteach model of pattern matching, or set the type of the camera which was used when the model of pattern matching was taught.

### 3.3.8.586 CVIS-602 Reference data corresponding to the specified model ID is not found.

Cause: Reference data corresponding to the specified model ID is not found.

Remedy: Check to make sure that the vision process has reference data for the specified model ID.

<!-- PDF page 346 -->

### 3.3.8.587 CVIS-603 Tag nesting too deep.

Cause: External model train file tag nesting is too deep.

Remedy: Check and fix the model train file format.

### 3.3.8.588 CVIS-604 External model train data is broken.

Cause: External model train file is broken.

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.589 CVIS-605 Tag not supported by the current tool type.

Cause: Current tool type does not support the specified tag.

Remedy: Check and fix the model train file format.

### 3.3.8.590 CVIS-606 This tag cannot be specified here.

Cause: This tag cannot be a child element of the current parent tag.

Remedy: Check and fix the model train file format.

### 3.3.8.591 CVIS-607 Specified vision tool not found.

Cause: A vision tool with the specified tool name does not exist.

Remedy: Check and fix the model train file.

### 3.3.8.592 CVIS-608 No model info in external model train file.

Cause: No information about the model is specified in the external model train file.

Remedy: Check and fix the model train file format.

### 3.3.8.593 CVIS-609 Invalid image for external model train.

Cause: Image name specified does not exist.

<!-- PDF page 347 -->

Remedy: Check and fix the model train file format. Write SNAP to snap a new image, or a filename in the format xxxx.BMP or xxxx.PNG to load an image to train a model with.

### 3.3.8.594 CVIS-610 Insufficient data to train model.

Cause: Required data is insufficient to train a model.

Remedy: Check and fix the model train file format.

### 3.3.8.595 CVIS-611 Model train mode conflict.

Cause: Cannot use both an image and graphics to train a model.

Remedy: Check and fix the model train file format.

### 3.3.8.596 CVIS-612 Invalid value.

Cause: The value specified is invalid for this tag.

Remedy: Check and fix the model train file format.

### 3.3.8.597 CVIS-613 Invalid attribute.

Cause: The attribute specified is invalid for this tag.

Remedy: Check and fix the model train file format.

### 3.3.8.598 CVIS-614 Dynamic window not supported.

Cause: External model train is not supported for tools with a dynamic search window.

Remedy: Choose another tool, or remove the window shift tool.

### 3.3.8.599 CVIS-615 Cannot form an arc.

Cause: The specified points may be too close, or the radius is too small.

Remedy: Check and fix the model train file.

<!-- PDF page 348 -->

### 3.3.8.600 CVIS-616 Trained model exceeds image size.

Cause: The model specified with graphics does not fit in the image.

Remedy: Check and fix the model train file.

### 3.3.8.601 CVIS-617 Model is not trained with an image.

Cause: The model is not trained with an image.

Remedy: Train the model using an image.

### 3.3.8.602 CVIS-618 Model train file error. (Line: %s)

Cause: Bad model train file format.

Remedy: See the cause and remedy for the following error code.

### 3.3.8.603 CVIS-619 External model train not supported.

Cause: Specified vision process does not support external model train.

Remedy: Train the model from UIF.

### 3.3.8.604 CVIS-620 Exceeded external model train daily limit.

Cause: Exceeded external model train daily limit.

Remedy: Increase the limit by changing $VISION_CFG.$VEMT_LIMIT.

### 3.3.8.605 CVIS-621 The strobe function of the digital camera is enabled.

Cause: The strobe function of the digital camera is enabled.

Remedy: Please disable strobe function of the digital camera.

### 3.3.8.606 CVIS-622 User frame number is different from the one when teaching.

Cause: User frame number is different from the one when teaching.

Remedy: Set the correct user frame number.

<!-- PDF page 349 -->

### 3.3.8.607 CVIS-623 Tool number is different from the one when teaching.

Cause: Tool number is different from the one when teaching.

Remedy: Set the correct tool number.

### 3.3.8.608 CVIS-624 Invalid position type.

Cause: Internal Error

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.609 CVIS-625 Not supported with this vision data.

Cause: Executed a vision program with a wrong vision data type.

Remedy: Check the type of the selected vision data.

### 3.3.8.610 CVIS-626 Parent aspect DOF must be 100%.

Cause: Parent aspect DOF result must be found with 100% for static background removal.

Remedy: Disable the aspect DOF of the parent command tool.

### 3.3.8.611 CVIS-627 Parent DOF result does not match the master data.

Cause: Parent DOF result must match the master data for static background removal.

Remedy: Disable the DOF of the parent command tool.

### 3.3.8.612 CVIS-628 Master file is too old to load.

Cause: The master file is too old, and this version of controller cannot load it.

Remedy: To use this file, you will either need to find a controller with older software, or reload this controller with older software.

### 3.3.8.613 CVIS-629 Master file is too new to load.

Cause: The master file is too new, and this version of controller cannot load it.

<!-- PDF page 350 -->

Remedy: Contact FANUC/FANUC America Corporation to obtain an updated version of your robot software.

### 3.3.8.614 CVIS-630 Master file is broken.

Cause: Master file is broken.

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.615 CVIS-631 Master file does not exist.

Cause: Master file does not exist.

Remedy: Use an existing master name.

### 3.3.8.616 CVIS-632 Master file is not specified.

Cause: Master file is not specified.

Remedy: Specify master file using prepared Karel program.

### 3.3.8.617 CVIS-633 Too small circle exists in master file.

Cause: Too small circle exists in master file.

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.618 CVIS-634 Too sharp angle exists in master file.

Cause: Too sharp angle exists in master file.

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.619 CVIS-635 Measurement range is not set

Cause: On the 3D Area Sensor Vision Process setup page, the [Range] is not set.

Remedy: Please set the [Range].

<!-- PDF page 351 -->

### 3.3.8.620 CVIS-636 Reference plane is not found.

Cause: Reference plane is not found.

Remedy: Confirm that the specified plane measurement tool actually measures plane.

### 3.3.8.621 CVIS-637 LED channel is out of range

Cause: The specified LED channel is out of range.

Remedy: Specify an LED channel within range.

### 3.3.8.622 CVIS-638 LED intensity is out of range

Cause: The specified LED intensity is out of range.

Remedy: Specify an LED intensity within range.

### 3.3.8.623 CVIS-639 LED is not supported in this configuration

Cause: LED is not supported in this configuration

Remedy: Please check the hardware configuration

### 3.3.8.624 CVIS-640 Cannot return packet

Cause: System error.

Remedy: Contact your FANUC technical representative.

### 3.3.8.625 CVIS-641 3D Map Storage is too small.

Cause: 3D Map Storage is too small.

Remedy: Please increase 3D Map Storage.

### 3.3.8.626 CVIS-642 3D Map Storage Allocation Error

Cause: Required 3D Map Storage is too large to allocate.

Remedy: Please reduce the 3D Map Storage and repower.

### 3.3.8.627 CVIS-643 Laser measurement tool is not trained

Cause: A laser measurement tool is not trained.

Cause: Internal Error

### 3.3.8.629 CVIS-645 Container Wall RM. is not valid

Cause: Container Wall RM. is not valid.

Remedy: Please tick Enable checkbox of Container Wall RM. in Area Sensor Preprocess Tool

### 3.3.8.630 CVIS-646 There is no container shape

Cause: There is no found container shape.

Remedy: Please FIND on Area Sensor Preprocess Tool

### 3.3.8.631 CVIS-647 Not enough Vision Tool Private Storage to process

Cause: Not enough Vision Tool Private Storage to process.

Remedy: Please increase Vision Tool Private Storage

### 3.3.8.632 CVIS-648 Specified Vision Tool Private Storage is not found

Cause: Specified Vision Tool Private Storage is not found.

Cause: Vision Tool Private Storage timeout.

Remedy: Contact your FANUC technical representative.

Cause: Vision Tool Private Storage internal error.

Cause: Specified Vision Data is in use.

Cause: GPM Statistic Function internal error.

Remedy: Contact your FANUC technical representative.

### 3.3.8.637 CVIS-653 Camera Disconnection internal error

Cause: Digital camera disconnection internal error.

Remedy: Contact your FANUC technical representative.

### 3.3.8.638 CVIS-654 DO to control MUX power is on

Cause: DO to control MUX power is ON.

Remedy: Please turn off this DO after turning off all the 3DL sensors.

### 3.3.8.639 CVIS-655 DO to control MUX power is off

Cause: DO to control MUX power is off.

Remedy: Please turn on this DO after checking the connections of 3DL seonsor and camera are stable.

<!-- PDF page 354 -->

### 3.3.8.640 CVIS-656 There is a MUX whose power is off

Cause: There is a MUX whose power is off.

Remedy: Please turn on the MUX whose power is off.

Cause: Can not control MUX power.

Remedy: Please check connections and arguments.

### 3.3.8.642 CVIS-658 The execution sequence is wrong.

Cause: Out of sequence internal error.

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.643 CVIS-659 Did not converge.

Cause: Robot did not converge to a designated position.

Remedy: Adjust the appropriate convergence limit

### 3.3.8.644 CVIS-660 There is no image.

Cause: Image has not been captured.

Remedy: Snap an image or read a saved image file.

### 3.3.8.645 CVIS-661 Work plane cannot be calculated.

Cause: Target plane could not be calculated.

Remedy: Make sure that all parts are on the same plane.

### 3.3.8.646 CVIS-662 Bad robot position.

Cause: The robot posture to snap the image is inappropriate.

<!-- PDF page 355 -->

Remedy: Make sure that the robot posture matches with the posture when the destination position was set.

### 3.3.8.647 CVIS-663 Target lost.

Cause: The target part cannot be found.

Remedy: The target part may have been moved or the view is obstructed. Test-run the problem image and adjust the detection parameters.

### 3.3.8.648 CVIS-664 Failed to set dest. position.

Cause: The object has not been found.

Remedy: Find the results before setting the destination position.

### 3.3.8.649 CVIS-665 Dest. position has not been set.

Cause: Destination position is not trained.

Remedy: Train the destination position first.

### 3.3.8.650 CVIS-666 The settings of the selected camera is incorrect for 3DL.

Cause: Because of the incorrect settings, The selected camera is not used for 3DL

Remedy: Correct the settings of the selected camera.

### 3.3.8.651 CVIS-667 The cylinder is not found

Cause: No cylinder was found from 3D Map. There may be the following cases. 1. The 3D Map is sparse. 2. The set of 3D points in 3D Blob is not suitable for the model to fit.

Remedy: Depending on the causes, adjust or re-teach the following items. 1. The settings of 3D Area Sensor. 2. [Min Num. Valid Points] and [Cyl. Error Threshold].

### 3.3.8.652 CVIS-668 Invalid Part Z Height

Cause: Part Z Height is invalid.

Remedy: Specify correct Part Z Height.

<!-- PDF page 356 -->

### 3.3.8.653 CVIS-669 The millimeter conversion setting was changed.

Cause: The millimeter conversion setting was changed.

Remedy: Re-train the comand tools with millimeter conversion.

### 3.3.8.654 CVIS-670 The blob is too large.

Cause: The blob is too large.

Remedy: Adjust the scale factor.

### 3.3.8.655 CVIS-671 The blob is too small.

Cause: The blob is too small.

Remedy: Adjust the scale factor.

### 3.3.8.656 CVIS-672 Can not convert to millimeters.

Cause: Can not convert to millimeters.

Remedy: Re-train a model by using the smaller scale factor.

### 3.3.8.657 CVIS-673 The scale factor is too large.

Cause: The scale factor is too large.

Remedy: Adjust the scale factor.

### 3.3.8.658 CVIS-674 Chromatic color pixels are too little

Cause: Chromatic color pixels are too little in the trained area. There may be the following cases. 1. The image is too dark or too bright. 2. The achromatic level is too high. 3. The illumination condition is not proper.

Remedy: Depending on the causes, adjust or re-teach the following items. 1. Adjust exposure time. 2. Adjust achromatic level. 3. Use the white light source and illuminate the workpiece uniformly.

<!-- PDF page 357 -->

### 3.3.8.659 CVIS-675 Multi colors are included in the trained area.

Cause: Multi colors are included in the trained area

Remedy: Train the area where the single color is included.

### 3.3.8.660 CVIS-676 Invalid color is trained.

Cause: Acquired image is too dark or too bright.

Remedy: Adjust exposure time to acquire more colorful image.

### 3.3.8.661 CVIS-677 The index of found part is out of range.

Cause: The index of found part is out of range.

Remedy: Enter the correct index within the range.

### 3.3.8.662 CVIS-678 The vision process specified in %s and the executed VP do not match.

Cause: The vision process specified in Vision Override and the executed VP do not match.

Remedy: Check the followings: 1. Whether the vision process name passed to RUN_FIND command is correct. 2. Whether the vision process name specified in Vision Override is correct.

### 3.3.8.663 CVIS-679 The vision tool specified in Vision Override does not exist in the executed VP.

Cause: The vision tool specified in Vision Override does not exist in the executed VP.

Remedy: Check the followings: 1. Whether the vision process name passed to RUN_FIND command is correct. 2. Whether the vision process name passed to IRVOVRDANYVP is correct. 3. Whether the vision tool name specified in Vision Override is correct.

### 3.3.8.664 CVIS-680 The property specified in Vision Override does not exist in the exexcuted VP.

Cause: The property specified in Vision Override does not exist in the exexcuted VP.

<!-- PDF page 358 -->

Remedy: Check the followings: 1. Whether the vision process name passed to RUN_FIND command is correct. 2. Whether the vision process name passed to IRVOVRDANYVP is correct. 3. Whether the property specified in Vision Override is correct.

### 3.3.8.665 CVIS-681 Learning mode conflict.

Cause: The target for learning cannot be changed.

Remedy: Clear the learning data, or use the same target for learning.

### 3.3.8.666 CVIS-682 Offset type conflict.

Cause: The selected offset type does not match with the trained data.

Remedy: Clear the trained data by selecting another camera data, or select an appropriate camera data.

Cause: The number of learned parts has reached its maximum, or a UF is used to calculate the offset plane.

Remedy: Clear the learning data, or uncheck the 'Fixed Plane' checkbox.

Cause: The robot position is not set.

Remedy: Set the robot position.

Remedy: Order and load either the iRConnect or ZDT options.

Cause: This is an alarm of Vision Learning Function. The format of the Learning Data file is too old, and the controller cannot load it.

Remedy: Remove the Learning Data file from the device specified as Log Path.

### 3.3.8.677 CVIS-693 Learning Data file is too new to load.

Cause: This is an alarm of Vision Learning Function. The format of the Learning Data file is too new, and the controller cannot load it.

Remedy: Remove the Learning Data file from the device specified as Log Path.

### 3.3.8.678 CVIS-694 Value in learning data is too big.

Cause: Input image is not selected.

Remedy: Select a input image.

### 3.3.8.723 CVIS-739 Resolution reduction level of input image is not valid.

Cause: Resolution reduction level of input image is not valid.

Remedy: Change resolution reduction level of input image or retrain this tool.

### 3.3.8.724 CVIS-740 Color Component tool is not trained.

Cause: Color Component tool is not trained.

Remedy: Train Color Component tool

### 3.3.8.725 CVIS-741 Flat Field tool is not trained.

Cause: Flat Field tool is not trained.

Remedy: Train Flat Field tool

### 3.3.8.726 CVIS-742 Image Arithmetic tool is not trained.

Cause: Image Arithmetic tool is not trained.

Remedy: Train Image Arithmetic tool

### 3.3.8.727 CVIS-743 Candidates of 3D Blob are too many.

Cause: Candidates of 3D Blob are too many.

<!-- PDF page 368 -->

Remedy: Please set up so that less 3D blobs are found. The larger [Z Height] for 3D blobs connection might be effective.

### 3.3.8.728 CVIS-744 Internal Error.

Cause: Internal error.

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.729 CVIS-745 There is a command tool which is not trained.

Cause: There is a command tool which is not trained above the treeview.

Remedy: Please train the untrained command tool above the treeview.

### 3.3.8.730 CVIS-746 There is no input 3D data.

Cause: There is no input 3D data.

Remedy: If you are using 3D Area Sensor, please call ACQVAMAP correctly or click [2-3D Snap] on the setup page.

### 3.3.8.731 CVIS-747 The parent tool is not trained.

Cause: The parent tool is not trained.

Remedy: Please train the parent tool.

### 3.3.8.732 CVIS-748 Trained auto exposure area is out of snap window.

Cause: Trained auto exposure area is out of snap window.

Remedy: Retrain auto exposure area.

### 3.3.8.733 CVIS-749 Trained multi exposure area is out of snap window.

Cause: Trained multi exposure area is out of snap window.

Remedy: Retrain multi exposure area.

<!-- PDF page 369 -->

# **3.3.8.734 CVIS-750 Trained snap window cannot be snapped by this camera.**

**Cause:** Trained snap window cannot be snapped by this camera.

**Remedy:** Retrain snap window.

# **3.3.8.735 CVIS-751 The result in VR is leaning.**

**Cause:** The result in Vision Register is leaning.

**Remedy:** Use a result not leaning against the offset frame.

# **3.3.8.736 CVIS-753 Fail to calibrate camera.**

**Cause:** The calibration of camera has failed. There might be some invalid calibration points.

**Remedy:** Delete invalid calibration points on the setup page of calibration.

# **3.3.8.737 CVIS-754 The multi exposure area is too narrow.**

**Cause:** The multi exposure area is too narrow.

**Remedy:** Retrain the multi exposure area.

# **3.3.8.738 CVIS-755 There is no valid reference position.**

**Cause:** There is no valid reference position.

**Remedy:** Please teach search window, measurement area or container again.

# **3.3.8.739 CVIS-756 No argument. %s**

**Cause:** A KAREL program has been executed with an argument missing.

**Remedy:** Please enter the correct argument.

# **3.3.8.740 CVIS-757 Bad argument. %s**

**Cause:** A KAREL program has been executed with an argument invalid.

**Remedy:** Please enter the correct argument.

<!-- PDF page 370 -->

# **3.3.8.741 CVIS-758 3D Area Sensor cannot be turned on/off.**

**Cause:** The camera connection/disconnection function does not support 3D Area Sensor.

**Remedy:** None.

# **3.3.8.742 CVIS-759 No offset type is selected**

**Cause:** The offset type has not been selected.

**Remedy:** Select an offset type.

# **3.3.8.743 CVIS-760 Temperature increases.**

**Cause:** The temperature of 3DV Sensor is rising.

**Remedy:** Cool down the 3DV Sensor.

# **3.3.8.744 CVIS-761 Temperature error.**

**Cause:** The led of 3DV Sensor is too hot and 3DV Sensor can not acquire.

**Remedy:** Cool down the 3DV Sensor.

# **3.3.8.745 CVIS-762 The sharpness is not valid.**

**Cause:** The bad sharpness is specified in the depth snap tool.

**Remedy:** Specify the valid value in the sharpness.

# **3.3.8.746 CVIS-763 3DV Sensor: load error.**

**Cause:** Data can not be loaded from 3DV Sensor.

**Remedy:** Check main board, FROM, multiplexer, cables and 3DV Sensor.

# **3.3.8.747 CVIS-764 Mounting position of 3DV Sensor is not trained.**

**Cause:** The mounting potision of 3DV Sensor is not trained.

**Remedy:** Train the mounting position of 3DV Sensor.

<!-- PDF page 371 -->

### 3.3.8.748 CVIS-765 The depth around big dots cannot be measured.

Cause: The big dots cannot be found.

Remedy: Snap a depth image again.

### 3.3.8.749 CVIS-766 The plane cannot be calculated.

Cause: The plane cannot be calculated.

Remedy: Snap a depth image again.

### 3.3.8.750 CVIS-767 Projection process failed.

Cause: The point to be projected is invalid, for example, it is behind the camera.

Remedy: Please confirm that parameters are proper.

### 3.3.8.751 CVIS-768 There is no valid 3D point.

Cause: There is no valid 3D point. The following causes are conceivable. * The target part is not in the camera-view. * The 3D snap condition is not proper for the part and there is no measured 3D point. * The [Meas. Z Range] in the vision process is not proper.

Remedy: Please resolve above causes.

### 3.3.8.752 CVIS-769 All 3D points are removed.

Cause: All 3D points are removed in 3D Data Preprocess Tool or 3D Data Generator Tool.

Remedy: Please confirm that parameters are proper in the above tool.

### 3.3.8.753 CVIS-770 Z-Axis is invalid.

Cause: 3D position and posture facing the other side of camera can't be projected to camera image. Or 2D position and posture can't be projected to the plane facing the other side of camera.

Remedy: Please take one of following countermeasures. 1. Please set up the offset frame correctly. The z-axis direction of the offset frame need to be roughly equal to the upward direction of the camera. 2. If you use 3DV Sensor Single View Vision Process, you can enable [Camera Base Find].

<!-- PDF page 372 -->

### 3.3.8.754 CVIS-771 There is no multiplexer.

Cause: There is no multiplexer.

Remedy: Please connect a multiplexer.

### 3.3.8.755 CVIS-772 3DV Sensor is not specified.

Cause: Camera data is not 3DV Sensor.

Remedy: Please specify a 3DV Sensor as camera data.

### 3.3.8.756 CVIS-773 The shape of model is incorrect

Cause: The shape of model to detect is incorrect.

Remedy: Please modify the model to detect.

### 3.3.8.757 CVIS-774 Camera command ID does not match

Cause: The camera command ID does not match.

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.758 CVIS-775 Camera parameter setting error.

Cause: Camera parameter error. This is an internal error.

Remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

### 3.3.8.759 CVIS-776 The file format isn't supported.

Cause: Can't read a file because its format isn't supported.

Remedy: Please confirm the file.

### 3.3.8.760 CVIS-777 Position adjustment not supported.

Cause: The parent result doesn't support 2D position adjustments.

<!-- PDF page 373 -->

Remedy: Please remove the tool which performs position adjustment.

### 3.3.8.761 CVIS-778 Camera mounting axis is not last axis.

Cause: Mounting a camera on the part of the robot between J1 axis and the last axis is not supported.

Remedy: None.

### 3.3.8.762 CVIS-779 User frame has been changed after teaching.

Cause: User frame has been changed after teaching.

Remedy: Please re-calibrate the camera.

### 3.3.8.763 CVIS-780 [Camera Installation] is unset.

Cause: Setup item [Camera Installation] is unset.

Remedy: Please set setup item [Camera Installation].

### 3.3.8.764 CVIS-781 [Camera Installation] and actual type of cameras in camera views are different

Cause: Setup item [Camera Installation] and actual type of cameras in camera views are different.

Remedy: Please change either setup item [Camera Installation] or actual type of cameras in camera views.

### 3.3.8.765 CVIS-782 Camera Views are not trained.

Cause: Camera views are not trained.

Remedy: Please setup camera view tools.

### 3.3.8.766 CVIS-783 There is no 3D points.

Cause: There is no 3D points.

Remedy: Please make sure the setup of Depth Snap Tool.

<!-- PDF page 374 -->

### 3.3.8.767 CVIS-784 Sensor is tilted more than 90 degree.

Cause: Sensor is tilted more than 90 degree.

Remedy: Please change sensor position.

### 3.3.8.768 CVIS-785 Selected Camera Data does not match logged Camera Data.

Cause: Selected Camera Data does not match logged Camera Data.

Remedy: Please set Camera Data as same as that of Log.

### 3.3.8.769 CVIS-786 USB Frame Grabber cannot be connected.

Cause: USB Frame Grabber is not connected.

Remedy: Please connect a USB Frame Grabber.

### 3.3.8.770 CVIS-787 This grabber type is not supported.

Cause: This grabber type is not supported.

Remedy: Please specify supported type of grabber.

### 3.3.8.771 CVIS-788 Vision Process %s failed to locate anything

Cause: Nothing was located by the vision process. This may be because the part is not in the camera field of view, or its characteristics have changed and it is no longer recognized by the vision system.

Remedy: If the correct part is present in the camera field of view, then adjust GPM parameters and/or dedicated vision system lighting. If the part is non-conforming, remove it from the system and restart production.

### 3.3.8.772 CVIS-789 Required target not located for %s

Cause: The vision process did not find a target or no target was present to detect

Remedy: If the correct target is present, parameters of the vision process may need to be adjusted
Lighting may also need to be adjusted in order to correctly identify the target

<!-- PDF page 375 -->

### 3.3.8.773 CVIS-790 Combine error too high for %s

Cause: All targets were located but the relationship between them exceeds the reference combine error limit. This may be caused by

1. The current part is non-conforming and should be removed from production.
2. The reflectiveness of a target is causing its location to appear incorrect.
3. Something other than the intended target is being located.

Remedy: Adjusting target parameters should only be done if the root cause of this error is well understood. Increasing the Max Combine Error should only be done if testing is done to ensure the new process value does not cause equipment damage.

### 3.3.8.774 CVIS-791 Intensity of 3DV Sensor is invalid.

Cause: Value of 3D Vision Sensor intensity is invalid.

Remedy: Please re-train the intensity of 3D Vision Sensor or depth snap tool.

### 3.3.8.775 CVIS-792 This camera data is not supported with this vision process

Cause: The camera data is not supported with the vision process.

Remedy: Please specify supported camera.

### 3.3.8.776 CVIS-794 Fail to export vision log.

Cause: Vision log could not be exported to the specified device.

Remedy: Check the deveices of input source and output destination.

### 3.3.8.777 CVIS-795 The part Z height is not set.

Cause: The part Z height is not set.

Remedy: Please set the part Z height.

### 3.3.8.778 CVIS-796 The logged image buffer is full.

Cause: The logged image buffer is full.

<!-- PDF page 376 -->

Remedy: Add 'CALL IRVWAITLOG' in a TP program in order to specify at which line the program can wait for completion of logging.

### 3.3.8.779 CVIS-797 Vision override was not found

Cause: The specified vision override does not exist.

Remedy: Check the vision override name, and enter the correct name.

### 3.3.8.780 CVIS-799 3DMV Auto Retry %s

Cause: The 3DMV Vision Process failed to locate the vehicle on the first attempt and is automatically reattempting vehicle location.

Remedy: This is only a notification. If successive attempts are unable to locate the vehicle, then another alarm will be posted.

### 3.3.8.781 CVIS-800 3DMV Robot Ring Not Configured

Cause: The 3DMV Offset Server (IRVOFFSV) aborted because there are no members in the Robot Ring.

Remedy: Configure the Robot Ring (RIPE) to allow Robot to Robot communications before trying to run the 3DMV Offset Server.

### 3.3.8.782 CVIS-801 Vision Comm Inactivity Reset

Cause: The 3DMV Vision Communication handshaking sequence was interrupted unexpectedly. This can occur if a robot requests vision offset data, but its TP programs are paused or aborted before the data is received.

Remedy: After a timeout occurs, the 3DMV Vision Offset Server robot automatically resets the handshaking sequence to clear out incomplete transactions. No action is necessary unless this warning occurs during production, or happens repeatedly whenever any communication attempt is made.

### 3.3.8.783 CVIS-802 ZDT for vision has been disabled in config settings.

Cause: ZDT has been selectively disabled from the vision related view in the ZDT setup menu

Remedy: If ZDT messages are desired go to the vision related view in the ZDT setup menu and check enable ZDT for iRVision.

<!-- PDF page 377 -->

### 3.3.8.784 CVIS-803 ZDT for vision queue is full.

Cause: ZDT queue for vision data is full

Remedy: If this message persists, consider increasing the queue size limit. If vision ZDT is not required, disable it from the Vision related view in the ZDT setup menu.

### 3.3.8.785 CVIS-804 ZDT for vision has exceeded the data limit.

Cause: ZDT for vision data size has exceeded the data limit

Remedy: If this message persists, consider increasing the data size limit

### 3.3.8.786 CVIS-805 Select a same type of 3DV Sensor for all camera views.

Cause: The type of selected 3DV Sensor is different from that in the other camera views.

Remedy: Select a same type of 3DV Sensor for all camera views.

## 3.4 D

### 3.4.1 DIAG Alarm Code

#### 3.4.1.1 DIAG-000 Execute CREATE first

Cause: _DIAG TP program doesn't exist.

Remedy: Go to UTILITY screen and execute CREATE function first.

#### 3.4.1.2 DIAG-001 Freq. Power limit (G:%d A:%d)

Cause: Primary frequencies power is over the threshold

Remedy: Please schedule service maintenance.

#### 3.4.1.3 DIAG-002 Group is not supported (G:%d)

Cause: Current running porgam includes the non-supported robots.

<!-- PDF page 378 -->

Remedy: Check supported robot models and make sure TP program includes these supported robot models

### 3.4.1.4 DIAG-003 Data process stops

Cause: Data collection/processing stops may cause by program paused

Remedy: Make sure TP program run successfully.

### 3.4.1.5 DIAG-004 Aggressive motion (G:%d A:%d L:%d P:%s)

Cause: Motion is aggressive

Remedy: Use iRDiagnostics Motion Profiler to identify the program and line and reduce speed/ACC or position

### 3.4.1.6 DIAG-005 Reducer load excess (G:%d A:%d L:%d P:%s)

Cause: Motion is too aggressive

Remedy: Use iRDiagnostics Motion Profiler to identify the program and line and reduce speed/ACC or position

### 3.4.1.7 DIAG-006 Aggressive motion (G:%d A:%d L:%d P:%s)

Cause: Motion is aggressive

Remedy: Use iRDiagnostics Motion Profiler to identify the program and line and reduce speed/ACC or position

### 3.4.1.8 DIAG-007 Reducer load excess (G:%d A:%d L:%d P:%s)

Cause: Motion is too aggressive

Remedy: Use iRDiagnostics Motion Profiler to identify the program and line and reduce speed/ACC or position

### 3.4.1.9 DIAG-008 Baseline prog changed (G:%d A:%d)

Cause: TP program used to generated the baseline data has changed

<!-- PDF page 379 -->

Remedy: Please re-master baseline data using the data generated by the new TP program

### 3.4.1.10 DIAG-009 G%d %s in %dhr

Cause: Maintenance is prompted

Remedy: Perform prompted maintenance

### 3.4.1.11 DIAG-011 Agressive reducer motion (G:%d, A:%s P:%s)

Cause: The indicated program is overly agressive and if run repeatedly may negatively impact the life of the reducer

Remedy: Use iRDiagnostics Motion Profiler to identify lines with agressive reducer load and reduce speed or ACC or position

### 3.4.1.12 DIAG-012 Agressive reducer motion (G:%d, A:%s P:%s)

Cause: The indicated program is overly agressive and if run repeatedly may negatively impact the life of the reducer

Remedy: Use iRDiagnostics Motion Profiler to identify lines with agressive reducer load and reduce speed or ACC or position

### 3.4.1.13 DIAG-013 Agressive reducer motion (G:%d, A:%s P:%s)

Cause: The indicated program is overly agressive and if run repeatedly may negatively impact the life of the reducer

Remedy: Use iRDiagnostics Motion Profiler to identify lines with agressive reducer load and reduce speed or ACC or position

### 3.4.1.14 DIAG-014 Agressive reducer motion (G:%d, A:%s P:%s)

Cause: The indicated program is overly agressive and if run repeatedly may negatively impact the life of the reducer

Remedy: Use iRDiagnostics Motion Profiler to identify lines with agressive reducer load and reduce speed

<!-- PDF page 380 -->

### 3.4.2 DICT Alarm Code

#### 3.4.2.1 DICT-001 Dictionary already loaded

**Cause:** A dictionary cannot be reloaded if it was loaded into FROM.

**Remedy:** Load into a different language and use KCL SET LANG to set the language.

#### 3.4.2.2 DICT-002 Not enough memory to load dict

**Cause:** There is no more permanent memory available in the system to load another dictionary.

**Remedy:** Clear all unnecessary programs, dictionaries or variables.

#### 3.4.2.3 DICT-003 No dict found for language

**Cause:** There are no dictionaries loaded for the specified language.

**Remedy:** Use the DEFAULT language or a language in which a dictionary has been loaded.

#### 3.4.2.4 DICT-004 Dictionary not found

**Cause:** The specified dictionary was not found.

**Remedy:** Use KCL LOAD DICT to load the dictionary into the DEFAULT language or the current language.

#### 3.4.2.5 DICT-005 Dictionary element not found

**Cause:** The dictionary element was not found.

**Remedy:** Check the dictionary or element number to be sure it is specified correctly.

#### 3.4.2.6 DICT-006 Nested level too deep

**Cause:** Only five levels of dictionary elements can be nested.

**Remedy:** Fix the dictionary text file to include fewer nested levels.

<!-- PDF page 381 -->

### 3.4.2.7 DICT-007 Dictionary not opened by task

Cause: The dictionary was never opened.

Remedy: Remove the close operation.

### 3.4.2.8 DICT-008 Dictionary element truncated

Cause: The dictionary element was truncated because the KAREL string array is not large enough to hold all the data.

Remedy: Increase either the size of the string or the number of strings in the array.

### 3.4.2.9 DICT-009 End of language list

Cause: The language list has completed.

Remedy: This is a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

### 3.4.2.10 DICT-010 End of dictionary list

Cause: The dictionary list has completed.

Remedy: This is a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

### 3.4.2.11 DICT-011 Dict opened by too many tasks

Cause: Only five dictionaries can be open by one task at one time.

Remedy: Load the dictionary to memory or close an unused dictionary.

### 3.4.2.12 DICT-012 Not enough memory to load dict

Cause: Not enough memory exists in TEMP pool on the controller. The dictionary was not loaded.

Remedy: This is a notification of insufficient memory resources on the controller. The hardware and software configurations need to be verified.

### 3.4.2.13 DICT-013 Cannot open dictionary file

Cause: The dictionary file does not exist on the specified device or in the specified directory.

<!-- PDF page 382 -->

**Remedy:** Select the proper device/directory and try again.

### 3.4.2.14 DICT-014 Expecting $ in dictionary file

**Cause:** The dictionary text incorrectly specifies an element without a $.

**Remedy:** Make sure all dictionary elements begin with $.

### 3.4.2.15 DICT-015 Reserved word not recognized

**Cause:** A reserved word was not recognized in the dictionary text.

**Remedy:** Check for misspelling or look up the correct word in the KAREL Reference Manual.

### 3.4.2.16 DICT-016 Ending quote expected

**Cause:** The dictionary text incorrectly specifies an element without using quotes.

**Remedy:** Make sure all dictionary text is surrounded by double quotes. Use a backslash if you want an actual quote to appear in the text. For example, \"This is an example\" will produce "This is an example".

### 3.4.2.17 DICT-017 Expecting element name or num

**Cause:** A reference to another element is expected.

**Remedy:** Use the element number to reference the element.

### 3.4.2.18 DICT-018 Invalid cursor position

**Cause:** The cursor position is specified incorrectly or the values are outside the limits.

**Remedy:** Make sure the cursor position is valid. For example, use @1,1 for the first row and col respectively.

### 3.4.2.19 DICT-019 ASCII character code expected

**Cause:** A series of digits are expected after the # to specify an ASCII character code.

**Remedy:** Remove the # or look up the ASCII character code in the KAREL Reference Manual.

<!-- PDF page 383 -->

### 3.4.2.20 DICT-020 Reserved word expected

Cause: An identifier is expected after the and to specify a reserved word.

Remedy: Remove the and or look up the reserved word in the KAREL Reference Manual.

### 3.4.2.21 DICT-021 Invalid character

Cause: An unexpected character was found in the dictionary text file.

Remedy: Make sure all dictionary text is correct.

### 3.4.2.22 DICT-022 Dict already opened by task

Cause: The dictionary is already open by the task.

Remedy: This is a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

### 3.4.2.23 DICT-023 Dict does not need to be opened

Cause: Dictionaries loaded to memory do not need to be opened.

Remedy: Do not try to open the dictionary file.

### 3.4.2.24 DICT-024 Cannot remove dictionary file

Cause: Dictionaries loaded to FROM cannot be removed or a dictionary cannot be removed if another task has it opened.

Remedy: Do not try to remove a dictionary loaded to FROM. Remove the dictionary from the same task which loaded it.

### 3.4.2.25 DICT-028 Not enough memory to load dict

Cause: Not enough memory exists in TEMP pool on the controller. The dictionary was not loaded.

Remedy: This is a notification of insufficient memory resources on the controller. The hardware and software configurations need to be verified.

<!-- PDF page 384 -->

### 3.4.2.26 DICT-029 Help element not found

Cause: The help dictionary element was not found.

Remedy: Check the dictionary to be sure the help dictionary element was specified correctly. The help dictionary element must be specified with a question mark (?) followed by the element number.

### 3.4.2.27 DICT-030 Function key element not found

Cause: The function key dictionary element was not found.

Remedy: Check the dictionary to be sure the function key element was specified correctly. The function key element must be specified with a caret (^) followed by the element number.

### 3.4.2.28 DICT-031 %4s-%03d $%8IX, no message found

Cause: The dictionary containing the error message could not be found.

Remedy: Refer to the System Reference Manual for the error message.

### 3.4.2.29 DICT-032 %4s-%03d, see posted error

Cause: The error message was posted to the error log.

Remedy: See error window or the Alarms menu for the error message.

### 3.4.2.30 DICT-040 Expecting element num after $

Cause: The dictionary text incorrectly specifies an element number.

Remedy: Make sure all dictionary elements begin with $ followed by the element number.

### 3.4.2.31 DICT-041 Expecting element name after ,

Cause: The dictionary text incorrectly specifies an element name.

Remedy: Make sure all dictionary elements are specified as ,element_name after the add constant name.

<!-- PDF page 385 -->

### 3.4.2.32 DICT-042 Expecting add constant name

Cause: The dictionary text was specified incorrectly.

Remedy: Make sure all dictionary elements are specified as +add_const_name after the element number.

### 3.4.2.33 DICT-043 Element number out of sequence

Cause: The dictionary text was not specified in sequence.

Remedy: Make sure all dictionary elements are specified in sequential order.

### 3.4.2.34 DICT-044 Warning - large hole in ele seq

Cause: The dictionary text has a large gap between element numbers.

Remedy: Reduce the gap in the element sequence. Each missing element uses up five bytes of memory.

### 3.4.2.35 DICT-045 .LIT or .END mismatch

Cause: The dictionary text was specified incorrectly.

Remedy: Verify that each .LIT is matched with a .END.

### 3.4.2.36 DICT-046 Command already encountered

Cause: The dictionary text was specified incorrectly.

Remedy: Remove the extra command.

### 3.4.2.37 DICT-047 File extension required

Cause: The dictionary compressor expects a file extension.

Remedy: Use the .etx file extension for error text, the .utx file extension for uncompressed text, or the .ftx file extension for form text.

<!-- PDF page 386 -->

### 3.4.2.38 DICT-048 Invalid file extension

Cause: The dictionary compressor did not recognize the file extension.

Remedy: Use the .etx file extension for error text, the .utx file extension for uncompressed text, or the .ftx file extension for form text.

### 3.4.2.39 DICT-049 Expecting file name

Cause: The dictionary compressor expects a file name.

Remedy: Specify a file name after the command.

### 3.4.2.40 DICT-050 Expecting facility number

Cause: The dictionary compressor expects a facility number in the .KL command.

Remedy: Specify the facility number after the file name.

### 3.4.2.41 DICT-051 Symbol invalid for dictionary type

Cause: An invalid command was specified for this type of dictionary file.

Remedy: Check the command and if a form is used, verify the file extension is .ftx.

### 3.4.2.42 DICT-052 Expecting .ENDFORM symbol

Cause: The dictionary text was specified incorrectly.

Remedy: Verify that each .FORM is matched with a .ENDFORM.

### 3.4.2.43 DICT-053 Cannot open include file

Cause: The include file could not be created.

Remedy: Make sure a valid file name has been specified.

### 3.4.2.44 DICT-054 Form is being displayed

Cause: The form you are trying to compress is currently being displayed.

<!-- PDF page 387 -->

Remedy: Abort the KAREL program that is displaying the form.

### 3.4.2.45 DICT-055 %% not allowed in KANJI string

Cause: %% is not allowed in KANJI string

Remedy: End the KANJI string with a single quote. Use double quotes around the format specifier and afterwards resume the KANJI string with single quotes.

### 3.4.3 DJOG Alarm Code

### 3.4.3.1 DJOG-000 Unknown error (DJ00)

Cause: System internal error

Remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation representative.

### 3.4.3.2 DJOG-001 DJOG overtravel violation

Cause: DJOG overtravel

Remedy: Release overtravel

### 3.4.3.3 DJOG-002 Motion control prog aborted

Cause: Program abort during DJOG enable

Remedy: Run the program

### 3.4.3.4 DJOG-003 Manual brake enabled

Cause: manual brake enabled

Remedy: Engage all the brakes and reset

### 3.4.3.5 DJOG-004 TP enabled during DJOG

Cause: TP enabled during DJOG

<!-- PDF page 388 -->

**Remedy:** Disable TP, RESET, resume Prog

### 3.4.3.6 DJOG-005 Prog has MCTL of DJOG group

**Cause:** DJOG attempt on attached group

**Remedy:** Disable DJOG, RESET, resume

### 3.4.3.7 DJOG-006 Robot not clear for DJOG

**Cause:** Robot not clear of DJOG cell

**Remedy:** Move robot or disable DJOG

### 3.4.3.8 DJOG-007 DJOG station fence open

**Cause:** Fence safety violation

**Remedy:** Insert fence connector, RESET

### 3.4.3.9 DJOG-008 DJOG axis limit

**Cause:** DJOG Axis limit reached

**Remedy:** Reset limit value if required

### 3.4.3.10 DJOG-009 Max group number exceeded

**Cause:** Max group number exceeded

**Remedy:** Reduce number of DJOG groups

### 3.4.3.11 DJOG-010 Max input number exceeded

**Cause:** Max input number exceeded

**Remedy:** Reduce starting point number

<!-- PDF page 389 -->

### 3.4.3.12 DJOG-011 Max output number exceeded

Cause: Max output number exceeded

Remedy: Reduce starting point number

### 3.4.3.13 DJOG-020 Unexpected DJOG packet

Cause: System internal error

Remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation representative.

### 3.4.3.14 DJOG-021 Bad data in DJOG packet

Cause: System internal error

Remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation representative.

### 3.4.3.15 DJOG-022 Uninitialized DJOG I/O

Cause: Uninitialized I/O

Remedy: Inspect I/O and/or I/O setup

### 3.4.3.16 DJOG-023 Uninitialized DJOG data

Cause: Uninitialized variable

Remedy: Inspect DJOG vars

### 3.4.3.17 DJOG-030 Motion control taken by prog

Cause: Program attempt to get MCTL

Remedy: Abort program or disable DJOG

### 3.4.3.18 DJOG-031 DJOG enabled

Cause: Run program while same group djog is enable

<!-- PDF page 390 -->

Remedy: Disable DJOG

### 3.4.4 DMDR Alarm Code

#### 3.4.4.1 DMDR-001 Adjust mode canceled G:%d M:%d

Cause: This will be reported when adjusting mode is canceled and normal mode is selected.

Remedy: Calibration will be lost when this error is posted. Calibration is required to run the program after canceling adjusting mode.

#### 3.4.4.2 DMDR-002 Master gets selected G:%d M:%d

Cause: This will be reported when a master axis is selected in adjusting mode.

Remedy: Set $DUAL_DRIVE.$ADJUST_SEL to 0 when you cancel adjusting mode. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

#### 3.4.4.3 DMDR-003 Slave gets selected G:%d M:%d

Cause: This will be reported when a slave axis is selected in adjusting mode.

Remedy: Set $DUAL_DRIVE.$ADJUST_SEL to 0 when you cancel adjusting mode. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

#### 3.4.4.4 DMDR-004 Wrong adjust number(G:%d M:%d)

Cause: This will be reported when a wrong number is selected in adjusting mode.

Remedy: Set $DUAL_DRIVE.$ADJUST_SEL to the valid number. Variable settings:

- 0: Both axes move coordinately
- 1: A master axis only moves.
- 2: A slave axis only moves.

NOTE: Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

#### 3.4.4.5 DMDR-005 Large position gap (G:%d M:%d)

Cause: The position inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$POS_GAP has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE.$POS_GAPTOL.

<!-- PDF page 391 -->

Remedy: See if no mechanical problem exists. Or, tune up $DUAL_DRIVE.$POS_GAPTOL properly again. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

### 3.4.4.6 DMDR-006 Large command gap1 (G:%d M:%d)

Cause: Motion command inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAP1 has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL1.

Remedy: See that no mechanical problem exists. Or tune up $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL1 properly again.

### 3.4.4.7 DMDR-007 Large command gap2 (G:%d M:%d)

Cause: Motion command inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAP2 has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL2.

Remedy: See that no mechanical problem exists. Or tune up $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL2 properly again.

### 3.4.4.8 DMDR-008 Large command gap3 (G:%d M:%d)

Cause: The motion command inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAP3 has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL3.

Remedy: See that no mechanical problem exists. Or, tune up $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL3 properly again.

### 3.4.4.9 DMDR-009 Large synch error (G:%d M:%d)

Cause: The servo error inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$SYNC_ER has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE.$SYNC_ER_TOL.

Remedy: See that no mechanical problem exists. Or, tune synchronous compensation parameters again. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

### 3.4.4.10 DMDR-010 Invalid dual axis config(G:%d)

Cause: Dual axis configuration is invalid.

Remedy: Check $DUAL_DRIVE.$M_AXIS_NUM and $DUAL_DRIVE.$S_AXIS_NUM.

<!-- PDF page 392 -->

### 3.4.4.11 DMDR-021 Selected adjust mode G:%d M:%d

Cause: This will be reported when you perform calibration under adjusting mode.

Remedy: Cancel adjusting mode first when you perform calibration. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

### 3.4.4.12 DMDR-031 Fail to get memory area

Cause: There is insufficient memory (DRAM) to allocate memory for the Dual-Drive option.

Remedy: Check the amount of memory(DRAM) being used by the system. Replace the CPU card to the one that has a larger memory size if necessary.

### 3.4.5 DMER Alarm Code

### 3.4.5.1 DMER-001 Adjust mode canceled G:%d M:%d

Cause: This will be reported when adjusting mode is canceled and normal mode is selected.

Remedy: Calibration will be lost when this error is posted. Calibration is required to run the program after canceling adjusting mode.

### 3.4.5.2 DMER-002 Master gets selected G:%d M:%d

Cause: This will be reported when a master axis is selected in adjusting mode.

Remedy: Set $DUAL_DRIVE.$ADJUST_SEL to 0 when you cancel adjusting mode. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

### 3.4.5.3 DMER-003 Slave gets selected G:%d M:%d
