Remedy:Specify thickness value in SPOT (or PRESS_MOTN) instruction.

### 3.18.13.316 SVGN-340 Prog:%s is write-protected.

Cause: Spot program touchup function could not modify program position, because file is write-protected.

Remedy: Disable write protection.

### 3.18.13.317 SVGN-341 Spot program touchup pending.

Cause: Spot program touchup has been enabled with execution mode = TOUCHUP mode during spot instruction execution, so spot program touchup will not start until next spot. Conditions leading to this message: 1. Start program with spot program touchup disabled 2. Pause program during execution of spot instruction 3. Enable spot program touchup (in TOUCHUP mode) 4. Resume (continue) program

Remedy: Note: purpose of this warning is operator notification, this is not a fault condition. In order to execute program touchup immediately, either execute shift backward (to restart spot) or abort program.

### 3.18.13.318 SVGN-342 Spot program verification enabled !

Cause: A tp program started (or resumed) and spot program touchup function is enabled with execution mode = VERIFY. Verify mode means that points will be evaluated but positions will NOT be modified.

Remedy: If touchup (not verify) mode is desired, change execution mode via Touchup setup screen: a. if tp is disabled, set Execution mode for AUTO = TOUCHUP mode, b. if tp is enabled, set Execution mode for TEACH = TOUCHUP mode, If normal spot (not touchup or verify) operation is desired, disable program touchup via: a. DIN, if tp is enabled. b. Touchup mode setup screen, if tp is disabled.

### 3.18.13.319 SVGN-343 Spot program verification pending.

Cause: Spot program touchup has been enabled in VERIFY mode during spot instruction execution, so spot program touchup will not start until next spot. Conditions leading to this case are: 1. Start program with spot program touchup disabled 2. Pause program during execution of spot instruction 3. Enable spot program touchup (in VERIFY mode) 4. Resume (continue) program

Remedy: Note: purpose of this warning is operator notification, this is not a fault condition. In order to execute program touchup immediately, either execute shift backward (to restart spot) or abort program.

<!-- PDF page 1736 -->

### 3.18.13.320 SVGN-344 Torque calibration incomplete.

Cause: Touchup was requested with torque control type 2, but torque calibration is incomplete.

Remedy: Complete touchup torque calibration or change $sggun#.$tchup.$updt_tq_typ=1 and $sggun#.$tchup.$updt_tq_typ=1

### 3.18.13.321 SVGN-345 Prog(%s): Read group msk failed.

Cause: Group mask could not read from specified program(). Refer to cause code (SVGN-347) for reason.

Remedy: Lookup error code for SVGN-347 and take appropriate action.

### 3.18.13.322 SVGN-346 Prog(%s): Write group msk failed.

Cause: Group mask could not be written to specified program(). Refer to cause code (SVGN-347) for reason.

Remedy: Lookup error code for SVGN-347 and take appropriate action.

### 3.18.13.323 SVGN-347 status:%s.

Cause: SVGN application alarm has occurred. This message merely reports the status (error) number that caused this problem.

Remedy: Lookup error code and take appropriate action.

### 3.18.13.324 SVGN-348 Panel deflect distance > 0.

Cause: considered to be detection failure (missing panel). However, in case of very soft gun and thin panel, gun position may be past point of closure (0). Increase $sggun#.$teach.$pnldflctdst for this case. However, if panel is not thin/soft and/or gun is rigid, this increase can lead to detection in absence of panel. This message is merely posted to warn of this possibility.

Remedy: Set panel deflect distance to 0, if panel and or gun are rigid. note: default setting of $pnldflctdst is 0.

### 3.18.13.325 SVGN-349 Thickness not measured.

Cause: Thickness is not measured.

Remedy: Refer to the error cause code.

<!-- PDF page 1737 -->

### 3.18.13.326 SVGN-350 Pressure release aborted.

Cause: Fault occurred or shift key was released while pressure release progress was active.

Remedy: Correct reason for fault and/or do not release shift key during pressure release.

### 3.18.13.327 SVGN-351 Nrm srch input error.

Cause: Norm search input DIN is invalid.

Remedy: Map norm search input to a valid input index via $SGNRMCFG[].$PNLDETDITYP and $SGNRMCFG[].$PNLDETDIIDX.

### 3.18.13.328 SVGN-352 Static tqlim ctrl required

Cause: Torque limit control is NOT equal to static type2, which provides best performance for normalization function.

Remedy: Go to torque limit control in teach setup screen. Select Static torque control type 2, and perform calibration

### 3.18.13.329 SVGN-353 Vx.mid-Vy.mid:%.2f overtol.

Cause: Gun open distance should be identical for vx.midpt and vy.midpt. Present difference exceeds tolerance, so one or more of the testpoints may be incorrect. Refer to manual for graphical explanation of this alarm.

### 3.18.13.330 SVGN-354 Vx.mid-TstPt0:%.2f overtol.

Cause: Gun open distance @vx.midpt should be same as pt0. Present difference exceeds tolerance, so one or more of the testpoints may be incorrect. Refer to manual for graphical explanation of this alarm.

Remedy: Confirm that detection result is correct. Redo tqlimit calibration if misdetection occurred.

<!-- PDF page 1738 -->

### 3.18.13.331 SVGN-355 Vy.mid-TstPt0:%.2f overtol.

Cause: Present difference exceeds tolerance, so one or more of the testpoints may be incorrect. Refer to manual for graphical explanation of this alarm.

Remedy: Confirm that detection result is correct. Redo tqlimit calibration if misdetection occurred.

### 3.18.13.332 SVGN-356 Max rot err too small (tstpt:%d).

Cause: Panel detection occurred sooner than expected (see orange block in search segment drawing in manual). This means that max rotation error is too small for the rotation error that actually exists in the path. Panel misdetection can also cause this alarm.

Remedy: Confirm that detection result is correct. Redo tqlimit calibration if misdetection occurred.

### 3.18.13.333 SVGN-357 w:%03.1f->%03.1f, p:%03.1f->%03.1f

Cause: Rotation change: org angle to normalized angle.

Remedy: Status message - no corrective action required.

### 3.18.13.334 SVGN-358 x+=%03.1f, y+=%03.1f, z+=%03.1f

Cause: X,Y coordinate change: org pos to normalized pos.

Remedy: Status message - no corrective action required.

### 3.18.13.335 SVGN-359 Invalid before nrm user prog.

Cause: B4nrmprgenb = TRUE and B4NRMPRGNM does not exist or is invalid.

Remedy: Set B4nrmprgenb = TRUE or create valid program with specified name.

### 3.18.13.336 SVGN-360 Invalid after nrm user prog.

Cause: AFnrmprgenb = TRUE and AFNRMPRGNM does not exist or is invalid.

Remedy: Set AFnrmprgenb = TRUE or create valid program with specified name.

<!-- PDF page 1739 -->

### 3.18.13.337 SVGN-361 Popup windows disabled.

Cause: Popup template files could not be found, and/or could not be displayed, so norm popup feature was disabled. Note that this message is posted at power-up only (one time).

Remedy: Refer to cause code.

### 3.18.13.338 SVGN-362 Normalize process failed.

Cause: Normalization process did not not complete. Refer to cause code for reason.

Remedy: Take appropriate action for this cause code.

### 3.18.13.339 SVGN-363 Invalid rbt close direction.

Cause: Robot close is not set to x,y or z. I.E. it is set to fix or an invalid direction.

Remedy: set robot clos direction to appropriate direction: +/-x, +/-y or +/-Z

### 3.18.13.340 SVGN-364 Invalid gun out direction.

Cause: Gun is not set to x,y or z.OR it is set to the same direction as robot close direction.

Remedy: set gun out direction to appropriate direction: +/-x, +/-y or +/-Z

### 3.18.13.341 SVGN-365 Number of iterations is invalid.

Cause: Number of iterations < 1.

Remedy: Set $SGNRMCFG[].$NUM_ITERS > 0.

### 3.18.13.342 SVGN-366 Speed range is invalid.

Cause: Specified speed range is invalid.

Remedy: Set $SGNRMCFG.$SPD_STRTVAL>0, and set $SGNRMCFG.$SPD_ENDVAL>= $SGNRMCFG.$SPD_STRTVAL.

### 3.18.13.343 SVGN-367 Radius range is invalid.

Cause: Specified radius range is invalid.

<!-- PDF page 1740 -->

Remedy: Set $SGNRMCFG.$RAD_STRTVAL>0, and set $SGNRMCFG.$RAD_ENDVAL>= $SGNRMCFG.$RAD_STRTVAL.

### 3.18.13.344 SVGN-368 Speed increment is invalid.

Cause: Specified speed increment is invalid.

Remedy: Set $SGNRMCFG.$SPD_INC_VAL > 0.

### 3.18.13.345 SVGN-369 Radius increment is invalid.

Cause: Specified radius increment is invalid.

Remedy: Set $SGNRMCFG.$RAD_INC_VAL > 0.

### 3.18.13.346 SVGN-370 Contact position is not correct

Cause: Gun tip contacted panel sooner than expected - either settings are incorrect or wrong panel is present. If correct panel is present, then confirm that following items are correct:

1. Thickness value.
2. Gun Zero Master position.
3. Gear ratio (tip displacement).

Remedy:

1. If thickness is incorrect, set proper thickness value in spot/pres_motn instruction.
2. If gun zero master is incorrect, go to servogun master screen and execute master or automaster.
3. If gear ratio is incorrect, go to gun setup util and set gun specs.

### 3.18.13.347 SVGN-371 Invalid Pressure Gain Tuning

Cause: Internal Servo Gun error.

Remedy: Record error and report to hotline.

### 3.18.13.348 SVGN-372 Uninitialized thickness: t=**

Cause: This value has not been specified in tp instruction.

<!-- PDF page 1741 -->

Remedy: Use measure thickness value to measure and enter thickness value automatically.
Alternatively, enter thickness value directly, via tp editor.

### 3.18.13.349 SVGN-373 Gun open required for autotuning.

Cause: Gun is pressuring (closed past 0). Auto tune can not start because pressure control is active.

Remedy: Jog gun open, to release pressure, then restart autotuning.

### 3.18.13.350 SVGN-374 Wear ratio update Locked.

Cause: 1 step measurement was performed with new tip. Wear ratio updating is loacked.

Remedy: To update wear ratio, 2 step measurement must be performed with new tip. This locking
is released by 2 step measurment. SVGN-288 is posted as cause code,it needs twice 2 step
measurement with currenct tip to update wear ratio SVGN-375 is posted as cause code, next 2
step measurement update wear ratio

### 3.18.13.351 SVGN-375 Next 2step TWD updates wear ratio.

Cause: 2 step measurement was performed after 1 step measurement has been performed with
new tip.

Remedy: No remedy.

### 3.18.13.352 SVGN-376 Internal TPP error LBL:%d

Cause: Internal servogun program error.

Remedy: Repower, go to control start, and then back to cold start. This action re-generates the
internal servogun program and may correct the problem. Record the error and report to hotline, if
the problem persists.

### 3.18.13.353 SVGN-377 Cold start required for ~svg update

Cause: Number of lines in ~svg is different than expected - program may be corrupt.

Remedy: Cold start and confirm that SVGN-377 is not posted again. If problem persists, contact
your FANUC technical representative.

<!-- PDF page 1742 -->

### 3.18.13.354 SVGN-378 Thickness measurement cancelled.

Cause: Thickness measurement process started, but did not complete. Completion may be due to a measurement error or program pause, during measurement.

Remedy: Identify specific cause of measurement failure, correct it, and execute thickness measurement again.

### 3.18.13.355 SVGN-379 Thickness table is empty.

Cause: Shift hardkey was pressed (to change manual pressure) but all values in thickness table are uninitialized.

Remedy: Set one (or more) values into the thickness table.

### 3.18.13.356 SVGN-380 Thickness table value/index is invalid.

Cause: Shift+Gun hardkey was pressed (to execute manual pressure operation) but thickness index and/or thickness value are invalid.

Remedy: Set one (or more) values into the thickness table and select a valid thickness by pressing Gun hardkey.

### 3.18.13.357 SVGN-381 Thk:%.1fmm, Press:%d%s,%.1fmm

Cause: This message is posted because thickness measurement was performed, and $SGCFG[].$THKMESCFG.$ALM4MESINFO = TRUE. This message merely provides a record of thickness measurement in the alarm log. It is not a fault/abnormal condition. Note: SVGN-176 is provided as cause code for this message to identify origin of thickness measurement request: Editor, Manual weld screen, thickness table screen, or Pressure Calibration screen.

Remedy: Set $SGCFG[].$THKMESCFG.$ALM4MESINFO = FALSE to disable this message.

### 3.18.13.358 SVGN-382 Tip could not contact with specified speed

Cause: Panel contact speed specified in pressure calibration table was not met. A slight amount of pressure error can occur because of this contact speed error. Root cause of contact speed error is insufficient gun open distance before pressure. The specific conditions that can cause this error are:

- Overly low distance in SD value
- Incorrect fixed tip position (taught position)
- Incorrect mastering position
- Incorrect thickness value

<!-- PDF page 1743 -->

Remedy: Confirm gun open distance, before pressure. Also, confirm fixed tip location, gun mastering, and thickness. Note: this warning can be ignored if panel does not vibrate, and weld quality is ok.

### 3.18.13.359 SVGN-383 Extra group motion

Cause: When extra groups are used in a robot+servogun program, motion of an extra group was detected during SPOT motion.

Remedy: None.

### 3.18.13.360 SVGN-384 Normalization supports UT frame type only.

Cause: Normalization is NOT supported for UF (pedestal) gun type.

Remedy: Change frame type to UT if possible.

### 3.18.13.361 SVGN-385 Prg tch mode swich err

Cause: Spot program touchup mode had become ENABLE immediately before spot instruction is executed.

Remedy: Make the spot program touchup mode ENABLE earlier.

### 3.18.13.362 SVGN-386 Robot bkup clamped:%.1fmm(%.1fdesired)

Cause: Requested robot backup distance cannot be provided, due to gun open limit. Actual robot backup provided is noted in the alarm.

Remedy: 1. Increase gun open limit if possible. 2. Reduce robot backup distance.

### 3.18.13.363 SVGN-387 Increase sglogarr size to log data.

Cause: Tune log and/or press log are enabled, but sglogarr size <= 1. Tune log and press log data files are created only if sglogarr size > 1.

Remedy: Set sglogarr size >1.

<!-- PDF page 1744 -->

### 3.18.13.364 SVGN-388 Speed noise hi:%.1fmm/sec(nom%.1f):%d

Cause: Variation in speed during observation period (before detection), is larger than speed variation observed during calibration. Number at end of message indicates phase. 1=Upper panel detection, 2=Lower panel detection. Root causes are: 1. Gun mechanical characteristics have changed or calibration is not up to date. 2. Current orientation is different than orientation used during calibration. 3. Open distance for current panel detection is greater than open distance used during calibration.

Remedy: 1. Redo calibration. 2. if problem persists, increase value of $SGSYSTCH.$P0SPDALMMGN.

### 3.18.13.365 SVGN-389 Search torq hi:%.1fkgf(nom%.1f):%d

Cause: Torque required for current search is larger than torque limit that was required to close gun during panel detection calibration. Number at end of message indicates phase: 1=Upper panel detection, 2=Lower panel detection. Root causes are: 1. Gun mechanical characteristics have changed or calibration is not up to date. 2. Current orientation is different than orientation used during calibration. 3. Open distance at panel detection is greater than open distance used during calibration.

Remedy: 1. Redo calibration. 2. if problem persists, increase value of $SGSYSTCH.$P0TRQALMMGN.

### 3.18.13.366 SVGN-390 Gun mode change detected while welding

Cause: Stroke/No Stroke mode might have been changed while executing spot welding program.

Remedy: To prevent spot welding point being skipped, the robot paused. Confirm Stroke/No Stroke mode.

### 3.18.13.367 SVGN-391 Torque CF cannot be calculated.

Cause: Torque conversion factor cannot be calculated because divide-by-zero is occurred.

Remedy: Confirm the gear ratio of servo gun.

### 3.18.13.368 SVGN-392 This TW**.TP is not supported.

Cause: This TWD program is for R-J3iB. R-30iB does not supported this.

Remedy: Replace TW***.TP to TWK***.PC like the following. Refer to servo gun function manual document.

<!-- PDF page 1745 -->

### 3.18.13.369 SVGN-393 Panel detection calib started.

Cause: Panel detection calibration has started. Note that detection calibration occurs during autotuning, and also when user invokes it on detection calibration screen.

Remedy: This message is provided for informational purposes only, it is not a problem.

### 3.18.13.370 SVGN-394 Panel detection calib ended.

Cause: Panel detection calibration has ended.

Remedy: This message is provided for informational purposes only, it is not a problem.

### 3.18.13.371 SVGN-395 Auto-zero calib started.

Cause: Automatic zero calibration has started. Note that detection calibration occurs during autotuning, and also when user invokes it on gun master screen.

Remedy: This message is provided for informational purposes only, it is not a problem.

### 3.18.13.372 SVGN-396 Auto-zero calib ended.

Cause: Automatic zero calibration process has ended.

Remedy: This message is provided for informational purposes only, it is not a problem.

### 3.18.13.373 SVGN-397 Thickness check calib started.

Cause: Thickness check calibration has started. Note that thickness check calibration occurs during autotuning, and also when user invokes it on gun setup util screen.

Remedy: This message is provided for informational purposes only, it is not a problem.

### 3.18.13.374 SVGN-398 Thickness check calib ended.

Cause: Thickness check calibration process has ended.

Remedy: This message is provided for informational purposes only, it is not a problem.

<!-- PDF page 1746 -->

### 3.18.13.375 SVGN-399 Speed(mm/sec) min:%.1f, max:%.1f

Cause: This alarm merely provides additional information for SVGN-274 alarm. Min speed and max speed specify speed range observed during panel detection preparation.

Remedy: Refer to SVGN-274

### 3.18.13.376 SVGN-400 Spot touchup+weld enabled !

Cause: A tp program started (or resumed) and spot program touchup function is enabled with execution mode = TCHUP + WELD. This means that points will be touched up, and then spot will execute.

Remedy: If touchup (not verify) mode is desired, change execution mode via Touchup setup screen: a. if tp is disabled, set Execution mode for AUTO = TOUCHUP mode, b. if tp is enabled, set Execution mode for TEACH = TOUCHUP mode, If normal spot (not touchup or verify) operation is desired, disable program touchup via: a. DIN, if tp is enabled. b. Touchup mode setup screen, if tp is disabled.

### 3.18.13.377 SVGN-401 Spot touchup+weld pending.

Cause: Spot program touchup has been enabled in TCHUP + WELD mode during spot instruction execution, so touchup process will not begin until next spot. Conditions leading to this case are: 1. Start program with spot program touchup disabled 2. Pause program during execution of spot instruction 3. Enable spot program touchup (in TCHUP + WELD mode) 4. Resume (continue) program

Remedy: Note: purpose of this warning is operator notification, this is not a fault condition. In order to execute touchup immediately, either execute shift backward (to restart spot) or abort program.

### 3.18.13.378 SVGN-402 Attach io wait time: %.1f(sec)

Cause: Power-up attach occurred, gun connect input and/or gunidentify input is mapped, and $SHC_CFG.$ATIO_WT_ALM = TRUE. This message is posted to report time waiting for attach io to become true.

Remedy: This alarm is not a problem. However, set $SHC_CFG.$ATIO_WT_ALM = FALSE, if you wish to disable this alarm.

<!-- PDF page 1747 -->

### 3.18.13.379 SVGN-403 Spot verify+weld enabled !

Cause: A tp program started (or resumed) and spot program touchup function is enabled with execution mode = VERIF + WELD. This means that points will be touched up, and then spot will execute.

Remedy: If touchup (not verify) mode is desired, change execution mode via Touchup setup screen: a. if tp is disabled, set Execution mode for AUTO = TOUCHUP mode, b. if tp is enabled, set Execution mode for TEACH = TOUCHUP mode, If normal spot (not touchup or verify) operation is desired, disable program touchup via: a. DIN, if tp is enabled. b. Touchup mode setup screen, if tp is disabled.

### 3.18.13.380 SVGN-404 Spot verify+weld pending.

Cause: Spot program touchup has been enabled in VERIF + WELD mode during spot instruction execution, so touchup process will not begin until next spot. Conditions leading to this case are: 1. Start program with spot program touchup disabled 2. Pause program during execution of spot instruction 3. Enable spot program touchup (in VERIF + WELD mode) 4. Resume (continue) program

Remedy: Note: purpose of this warning is operator notification, this is not a fault condition. In order to execute touchup immediately, either execute shift backward (to restart spot) or abort program.

### 3.18.13.381 SVGN-405 WeldComp: Prg=%s, Ln=%d

Cause: Program touchup executed with execution mode set to TCHUP+WELD or VERIFY+WELD. This message indicates that weld operation completed, after tchup (or verify) for this line.

Remedy: This is merely a warning for feedback/confirmation. Set $SGBTCHTCH[].$WRN4WLDCMPL = FALSE, if you do not wish to display this message.

### 3.18.13.382 SVGN-406 Opened:%s successfully.

Cause: Specified TP program was opened successfully. Note that this message is only posted after a program open failure.

Remedy: No action is needed. This alarm is merely a message to inform you that a corrective action was performed.

<!-- PDF page 1748 -->

### 3.18.13.383 SVGN-407 Open:%s failed.

Cause: Specified TP program could not be opened - program may have been cleared. Refer to cause code for reason.

Remedy: This program should already exist in memory, so open failure is unexpected. If open failure occurs, system reloads program from FRS, and no action is required. This alarm is reported to inform user that corrective action has been taken. Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative, if problem persists.

### 3.18.13.384 SVGN-408 Loaded:%s successfully

Cause: Specified TP program was loaded. Note that this message is only posted after a file load failure.

Remedy: No action is needed. This alarm is merely a message to inform you that a corrective action was performed.

### 3.18.13.385 SVGN-409 Load:%s failed.

Cause: Specified TP program could NOT be loaded - program may have been deleted. Refer to cause code for reason.

Remedy: This program should always on FRS, so load failure is unexpected. Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

### 3.18.13.386 SVGN-410 Close:%s failed.

Cause: Specified TP program could NOT be closed. Refer to cause code for reason.

Remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

### 3.18.13.387 SVGN-411 Get line failed(%s).

Cause: TP Line data could not be read, for specified program at line. TP program may be corrupt, so it was automatically cleared. See cause code for more details.

Remedy: Re-execute current process again: program will reload and line data will be read again. Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative if problem persists.

<!-- PDF page 1749 -->

### 3.18.13.388 SVGN-412 Set line failed(%s).

Cause: TP Line data could not be set, for specified program at line. TP program may be corrupt, so it was automatically cleared. See cause code for more details.

Remedy: Re-execute current process again: program will reload and line data will be set again. Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative if problem persists.

Cause: Pressure Check Init Start

Remedy: No remedy.

### 3.18.13.390 SVGN-414 Pressure Check Init Complete

Cause: Pressure Check Init Complete

Remedy: No remedy.

Cause: Pressure Check Tolerance Exceed

### 3.18.13.392 SVGN-416 Pressure Adjustment Tol Exceed

Cause: Pressure Adjustment Tolerance Exceed

Remedy: No remedy. Confirm Gun Condition.

### 3.18.13.393 SVGN-417 Select Non-Adaptive2 GUN:%d

Cause: Search motion is done, but upper detect condition is not set Non-Adaptive2 mode.

<!-- PDF page 1750 -->

### 3.18.13.394 SVGN-418 Det offset for Simple search enabled !

Cause: A tp program started (or resumed) and spot program touchup function is enabled with execution mode = MEAS OFS.

Remedy: If touchup (not measure offset) mode is desired, change execution mode via Touchup setup screen: Set Execution mode for TEACH = TOUCHUP mode,

### 3.18.13.395 SVGN-419 Det offset for Simple search pending.

Start program with spot program touchup disabled 2. Pause program during execution of spot instruction 3. Enable spot program touchup (in MEAS OFS mode) 4. Resume (continue) program

Remedy: Note: purpose of this warning is operator notification, this is not a fault condition. In order to execute program touchup immediately, either execute shift backward (to restart spot) or abort program.

### 3.18.13.396 SVGN-420 TOUCHUP Pass check mode enabled !

Cause: A tp program started (or resumed) and spot program touchup function is enabled with execution mode = PASS CHECK.

### 3.18.13.397 SVGN-421 TOUCHUP Pass check mode pending.

Cause: Spot program touchup has been enabled in PASS CHECK mode during spot instruction execution, so spot program touchup will not start until next spot. Conditions leading to this case are: 1. Start program with spot program touchup disabled 2. Pause program during execution of spot instruction 3. Enable spot program touchup (in PASS CHECK mode) 4. Resume (continue) program

Remedy: Note: purpose of this warning is operator notification, this is not a fault condition. In order to execute program touchup immediately, either execute shift backward (to restart spot) or abort program.

### 3.18.13.398 SVGN-422 Incorrect Override

Cause: Incorrect Override

<!-- PDF page 1751 -->

Remedy: Set correct override

### 3.18.13.399 SVGN-423 Fixed tip capwear:%s(limit).

Cause: Cap wear value exceeds value specified in $TWGUN. Note: value in %s is a string with the following format: w1mm > w2. Where: w1 = current wear value, w2 = max wear value. For example, if w1=6mm, w2=5mm, the alarm will display as SVGN-423 Fixed tip capwear: 6.0mm > 5.0(limit)

Remedy: Replace cap or increase value in $TWGUN.

### 3.18.13.400 SVGN-424 Movable tip capwear:%s(limit)

Cause: Cap wear value exceeds value specified in $TWGUN. Note: value in %s is a string with the following format: w1mm > w2. Where: w1 = current wear value, w2 = max wear value. For example, if w1=6mm, w2=5mm, the alarm will display as SVGN-424 Fixed tip capwear: 6.0mm > 5.0(limit)

Remedy: Replace cap or increase value in $TWGUN.

### 3.18.13.401 SVGN-425 Fixed tip wear rate:%s overtol.

Cause: Rate of wear exceeds tolerance specified in $TWGUN.

Remedy: Confirm that wear value is not excessive, for this number of spots.

### 3.18.13.402 SVGN-426 Movable tip wear rate:%s overtol.

Cause: Rate of wear exceeds tolerance specified in $TWGUN.

Remedy: Confirm that wear value is not excessive, for this number of spots.

### 3.18.13.403 SVGN-427 Fixed tip wear%%:%s overtol.

Cause: Wear percentage exceeds tolerance specified in $TWGUN.

Remedy: Confirm that spot process is operating correctly.

### 3.18.13.404 SVGN-428 Movable tip wear%%:%s overtol.

Cause: Wear percentage exceeds tolerance specified in $TWGUN.

<!-- PDF page 1752 -->

Remedy: Confirm that spot process is operating correctly.

### 3.18.13.405 SVGN-429 Fixed tip compression:%s overtol.

Cause: Gun tip compression (non-capwear change) exceeds tolerance specified in $TWGUN. Ideally, gun tip compression should be 0. However, compression can become greater than 0 over time, because electrode get pushed into holder (tapered pipe fit).

Remedy: Replace electrode / tip holder.

### 3.18.13.406 SVGN-430 Movable tip compression:%s overtol.

Cause: Gun tip compression (non-capwear change) exceeds tolerance specified in $TWGUN. Ideally, gun tip compression should be 0. However, compression can become greater than 0 over time, because electrode get pushed into holder (tapered pipe fit).

Remedy: Replace electrode / tip holder.

### 3.18.13.407 SVGN-431 Max wear not reachable(clslim=%s)

Cause: Close stroke limit is less than max wear value. Gun tip compression is too large and/or close limit is too small.

Remedy: Increase stroke limit, if possible (if new limit does not exceed extension of leadscrew). Replace electrode / tip holder, if gun tip compression is large.

### 3.18.13.408 SVGN-432 Nominal:%s, Tolerance:%s

Cause: Cause message posted with alarms 425-430 for additional info.

Remedy: None - SVGN-432 is merely supplemental info for main alarm.

### 3.18.13.409 SVGN-433 Insufficient memory for TWDIAG

Cause: $TWGUN#V#[] could not be created due to lack of memory.

Remedy: Increase memory or reduce $TWSYSCFG.$ARCHIVDIMRQ.

### 3.18.13.410 SVGN-434 Wear(%s) Compress(%s)

Cause: Cause message posted with alarm 431 for additional info.

<!-- PDF page 1753 -->

Remedy: Replace caps if wear is too large. Replace shank/cap adapter if compression is too large.

### 3.18.13.411 SVGN-435 Open robot tip & search again.

Cause: Direction of Lower panel search motion was wrong.

Remedy: Open robot tip with following ways and retry. In Spot point touchup, open robot tip by jog. In Spot program touchup, set larger value to SPTCH_RSD instruction, Lower panel detection

### 3.18.13.412 SVGN-436 Deflection cal pt2 <= minimum_trq.

Cause: Calibration point 2 torque value <= $minimum_trq. Therefore, torque value for calpt2 = calpt1. Torque values must be increasing.

Remedy: Increase torque value for calibration point2.

### 3.18.13.413 SVGN-437 Gun position exceeds openlimit.

Cause: Thickness check calibration opens gun to original position after calibration, but original (current) position is unreachable, because it is past open stroke limit. Thickness check calibration could not start because of this error.

Remedy: 1. Jog gun in close direction, until open limit is not exceeded.

### 3.18.13.414 SVGN-438 [MP_SPOT]Invalid params.

Cause: Invalid parameters are used at MP_SPOT#.

Remedy: Refer to a cause code. And correct them.

### 3.18.13.415 SVGN-439 [MP_SPOT]Over max retry num.

Cause: Retry number > allowable retry number.

Remedy: Reset this alarm and restart when this was occurred by pressing HOLD. Reset other alarms and restart when this was occurred at other situations.

### 3.18.13.416 SVGN-440 [MP_SPOT]SUB%s is not exist.

Cause: Sub-sequence is not registered.

<!-- PDF page 1754 -->

Remedy: Confirm Sub-sequence number displayed this message is registered.

### 3.18.13.417 SVGN-441 Pressure profile by DI time out

Cause: Specified DI is not asserted in time.

Remedy: Assert specified DI in time.

### 3.18.13.418 SVGN-442 Conflict of forced step signal

Cause: Both forced 1 step signal and forced 2 step signal are input

Remedy: Input either one of forced 1 step signal and forced 2 step signal.

### 3.18.13.419 SVGN-443 Forced 1step signal for new tip

Cause: Forced 1 step signal is asserted for new tip

Remedy: Assert either one of forced 1 step signal and new tip flag.

### 3.18.13.420 SVGN-444 Invalid io cfg (auto-detect tw)

Cause: Invalid IO configuration for tw meas auto-detection has been found.

Remedy: Confirm IO configuration for tw meas auto-detection.

### 3.18.13.421 SVGN-445 %s not created, CMOS:%d too low

Cause: Specified variable could not be created, because free CMOS is too low. Free CMOS must be > ($SGSYSCFG.$MINFREECMOS + additional memory for new var). Current value of free CMOS (kbytes) is noted in alarm message.

Remedy: Increase CMOS memory or decrease size of new variable allocation.

### 3.18.13.422 SVGN-446 %s not created, DRAM:%d too low

Cause: Specified variable could not be created, because free DRAM is too low. Free CMOS must be > ($SGSYSCFG.$MINFREEDRAM + additional memory for new var). Current value of free DRAM (kbytes) is noted in alarm message.

Remedy: Increase DRAM memory or decrease size of new variable allocation.

<!-- PDF page 1755 -->

### 3.18.13.423 SVGN-447 %s not created, FROM:%d too low

Cause: Specified variable could not be created, because free FROM is too low. Free FROM must be > ($SGSYSCFG.$MINFREEFROM + additional memory for new var). Current value of free FROM (kbytes) is noted in alarm message.

Remedy: Increase FROM memory or decrease size of new variable allocation.

### 3.18.13.424 SVGN-448 %s chg: gunct:%d,%d dim:%d,%d

Cause: Number of guns or log length Variables for specified variable have changed. Message identifies previous old, new gun count and old, new variable dimension.

Remedy: None. This message is posted for memory tracking purposes, NOT problem notification.

### 3.18.13.425 SVGN-449 Memory decrease: DRAM:%d FROM:%d

Cause: DRAM and FROM Memory have decreased by specified amount (kbytes). Note: positive value means memory decrease, negative value means memory increase.

Remedy: None. This message is posted for memory tracking purposes, NOT problem notification.

### 3.18.13.426 SVGN-450 Profile step%d timeout:%dms

Cause: Total time elapsed during step exceeds step wait limit. This can occur, if DIN to start step is unmet, or timeout value is too short. See alarm message for StepId and elapsed time are reported.

Remedy: Increase timeout value: $SGPPDCFG.$STEP_WTLIM.

### 3.18.13.427 SVGN-451 Motionless fctrl switching disabled.

Cause: PosLok was requested, but motionless force control switching is disabled.

Remedy: Set $SGSYSCFG.$NOMOTN_FCSW = TRUE.

### 3.18.13.428 SVGN-452 Gun close required for fctrl change

Cause: FCTRL change was requested, but gun closed flag is not set.

Remedy: Set $sgcfg[].$nomotn_fcsw=TRUE, $sgsyscfg.$fctlmgr_enb=TRUE and execute spot/press_motn instruction, prior to fctrl change request.

<!-- PDF page 1756 -->

### 3.18.13.429 SVGN-453 Servo follow-up timeout

Cause: Pressurization time time exceeded due to follow-up.

Remedy: Disabled follow during pressuring motion or increase $info[1].$wait_lim.

### 3.18.13.430 SVGN-454 Force control request timeout

Cause: Force control mode change did not change within expected time.

Remedy: Increase $syscfg.$fc.$wtmx. If this does not fix the problem, contact your FANUC technical representative.

### 3.18.13.431 SVGN-455 Fctrl request cleared due to gun motion

Cause: Motion instruction was called, after force control request was asserted. Motion control has precedence over force control, so force control was cancelled.

Remedy: Call instruction CTRL_POSITION, prior to motion instruction. Note that this is only necessary if CTRL_PRESSURE[] was called, previously.

### 3.18.13.432 SVGN-456 User config mismatch:%d

Cause: User press instruction was called, but current setting does not match. Setting that was applied at last cold start. Refer to code for specific reason.

Remedy: Change user press request or perform cold start.

### 3.18.13.433 SVGN-457 User press disabled

Cause: TP program called usr press instruction, but user press function is disabled.

Remedy: Set $SGUSRCFG[].$USR_PRS_ENB = TRUE.

### 3.18.13.434 SVGN-458 NEED APPLY for user press cfg.

Cause: User press config has changed, and/or ~svg program is stale.

Remedy: Go to user config screen and press apply(F3), then perform cold start.

<!-- PDF page 1757 -->

### 3.18.13.435 SVGN-459 Not supported with dual gun

Cause: Instruction was called, and equipment type == dual gun. Dual gun is not supported with this option / instruction/

Remedy: Use standard spot or press_motn instruction.

### 3.18.13.436 SVGN-460 User config was applied

Cause: User config specification was applied.

Remedy: This message is merely provided for confirmation, it is not a prolem.

### 3.18.13.437 SVGN-461 User config NOT applied(%x)

Cause: User config specification could not be applied. Apply operation was cancelled. Typically, this is due to program being open (paused) and hot start being performed. Refer to error code in parentheses for reason.

Remedy: Abort program and repower or perform cold start. If problem persists, record error code and contact your FANUC technical representative.

### 3.18.13.438 SVGN-462 Sub-program%d does not exist.

Cause: User subprogram# does not exist. 1: before pressure subprogram 2: after pressure subprogram 3: after open subprogram

Remedy: Create specified program or go to user config screen and specify new program name or disable this program.

### 3.18.13.439 SVGN-463 Error(s) exist in usrcfg.

Cause: Specified user config is invalid.

Remedy: Refer to screen for specific reason and correct it.

### 3.18.13.440 SVGN-464 ~svg_m%d%d line count is invalid.

Cause: Linecount of internal program is invalid.

Remedy: Perform a Cold start to recreate the internal program. Contact your FANUC technical representative, if the problem persists.

<!-- PDF page 1758 -->

### 3.18.13.441 SVGN-465 ~svg_m%d%d is stale(%d).

Cause: Internal program rewrite failed when controller powered up. Typically, this occurs because program was open (paused) when rewrite was attempted at power-up.

Remedy: Press re-apply on user config screen and cold start to recreate the internal program.

### 3.18.13.442 SVGN-466 Internal error: Re-power required.

Cause: Internal spot program touch-up program error.

Remedy: Repower, go to control start, and then back to cold start. This action re-generates the internal spot program touch-up program and may correct the problem.

### 3.18.13.443 SVGN-467 Time (exp:%d,obs:%d) ct:%d

Cause: This is additional info for SVGN-450 alarm. Time expected = duration (ms) programmed in pressure schedule. Time observed = duration (ms) observed when timeout occurred. Ct is internal duration info used by FANUC for troubleshooting.

Remedy: Please refer to SVGN-450.

### 3.18.13.444 SVGN-468 Profile truncated:%d (exp:%d,obs:%d)

Cause: Pressure profile truncation occurred - full pressure profile did not execute. Number to right of truncated is profile phase where this occurred: 1=before weld, 2=during weld, 3=after weld. SVGN-468 is not necessarily a problem, because pressure sequence that executes after weld complete ( in weld phase) may not be required. However, if weld complete should not occur prior to pressure sequence completion, it is a problem and is duly noted.

Remedy: Increase weld duration or reduce duration of steps during weld pressure sequence. Alternatively, set $sgppdcfg.$steptruncer = 0 to disable this alarm. $steptruncer | 0x1: Enable phase 1 check (before weld) $steptruncer | 0x2: Enable phase 2 check (during weld)

### 3.18.13.445 SVGN-469 Position data update failed.

Cause: Position data cannot update in Spot Program Touchup Function.

Remedy: If there is differnce in axes configuration between current system and position data before touchup, position data cannot update by Spot program Touchup Function.

<!-- PDF page 1759 -->

### 3.18.13.446 SVGN-470 Prs incre exceed abnl up lim:G%d

Cause: Pressure increase exceeded abnormal pressure increase upper limit value.

Remedy: Confirm the motor temperature.

### 3.18.13.447 SVGN-471 Prs decre below abnl low lim:G%d

Cause: Pressure decrease below abnormal pressure decrease lower limit value.

Remedy: Confirm the motore temperature.

### 3.18.13.448 SVGN-472 Mastering pressure was modified

Cause: Mastering pressure has been modified.

Remedy: Perform the tip wear setup procedure again.

### 3.18.13.449 SVGN-473 Specified pressure value is invalid.

Cause: Specified pressure value at pressure profile is invalid.

Remedy: Specify valid pressure value.

### 3.18.13.450 SVGN-474 Specified index is invalid.

Cause: Specified index at pressure profile is invalid.

Remedy: Specify valid index value.

### 3.18.13.451 SVGN-475 Fixed tip comprs rate:%s overtol.

Cause: Fixed tip compression rate (change) is overtol. Tip adapter may be mislocated.

Remedy: If there is differnce in axes configuration between current system and position data before touchup, Adjust tip adapter or increase tolerance of tip comprssion rate change.

### 3.18.13.452 SVGN-476 Movable tip comprs rate:%s overtol.

Cause: Movable tip compression rate (change) is overtol. Tip adapter may be mislocated.

<!-- PDF page 1760 -->

Remedy: If there is difference in axes configuration between current system and position data before touchup, Adjust tip adapter or increase tolerance of tip compression rate change.

### 3.18.13.453 SVGN-477 Nominal poke pressure is uninit.

Cause: Nominal poke pressure value specified in pressure schedule is uninit. Poke check cannot be performed because poke pressure is unspecified.

Remedy: Go to pressure schedule screen and either: 1. perform poke measurement (to measure and enter pressure automatically) 2. manually enter nominal poke pressure.

### 3.18.13.454 SVGN-478 Poke speed is uninit.

Cause: Poke speed value specified in pressure schedule is uninit.

Remedy: Go to pressure schedule screen and enter poke speed.

### 3.18.13.455 SVGN-479 Poke distance is uninit.

Cause: Poke distance value specified in pressure schedule is uninit.

Remedy: Go to pressure schedule screen and enter poke distance.

### 3.18.13.456 SVGN-480 Poke press low tol is uninit.

Cause: Poke pressure low tol specified in pressure schedule is uninit.

Remedy: Go to pressure schedule screen and enter poke pressure low tol.

### 3.18.13.457 SVGN-481 Poke press high tol is uninit.

Cause: Poke pressure high tol specified in pressure schedule is uninit.

Remedy: Go to pressure schedule screen and enter poke pressure high tol.

### 3.18.13.458 SVGN-482 Prelod distance is uninit.

Cause: Prelod distance value specified in pressure schedule is uninit.

Remedy: Go to pressure schedule screen and enter prelod distance.

<!-- PDF page 1761 -->

### 3.18.13.459 SVGN-483 Prelod distance >= poke distance.

Cause: Invalid gun number was specified in $SGLOGINF.GUN_NUM. Value specified must correspond to a valid servogun number.

Remedy: Go to poke schedule screen and reduce preload distance or increase poke distance.

### 3.18.13.460 SVGN-484 EQZ is disabled when OVR < 100%

Cause: Equalization is disabled when override is smaller than 100%

Remedy: None. This message is NOT problem notification.

### 3.18.13.461 SVGN-485 EQZ is disabled when single step

Cause: Equalization is disabled when single step mode is enabled.

Remedy: None. This message is NOT problem notification.

### 3.18.13.462 SVGN-486 Cap/Panel is missing: Gun%d

Cause: Pressure shortage has occurred, and $sgsyscfg.$pst_ertyp message flag is enabled.

Remedy: Insert panel with appropriate thickness and/or update thickness value. If thickness is ok, then replace caps if they are worn. To disable this alarm, set $sgsyscfg.$pst_ertype = 0. Note: if this alarm is disabled, then SVGN-020 will be posted. SVGN-486 or SVGN-487 is posted in lieu of SVGN-020 when this alarm is enabled.

### 3.18.13.463 SVGN-487 Cap/Panel is missing: Gun%d

Cause: Pressure shortage has occurred, and $sgsyscfg.$pst_ertyp message flag is enabled.

Remedy: Insert panel with appropriate thickness and/or update thickness value. If thickness is ok, then replace caps if they are worn. To disable this alarm, set $sgsyscfg.$pst_ertype = 0. Note: if this alarm is disabled, then SVGN-020 will be posted. SVGN-486 or SVGN-487 is posted in lieu of SVGN-020 when this alarm is enabled.

### 3.18.13.464 SVGN-488 Communication port is not initialized.

Cause: The communication port for IRWC-T is not initialized.

Remedy: Initialize the communication port for IRWC-T.

<!-- PDF page 1762 -->

### 3.18.13.465 SVGN-489 Connection preparation NG (%s)

Cause: The connection preparation sequence with IRWC-T failed.

Remedy: Check the IRWC-T

### 3.18.13.466 SVGN-490 Connection preparation OK

Cause: The connection preparation sequence with IRWC-T succeeded.

Remedy: This is just a message. There is no need to be careful.

### 3.18.13.467 SVGN-494 GunA must be specified for dual guns.

Cause: GunB (2nd gun of dual gun pair) was specified in the gun attach or detach instuction. GunA (1st gun of dual gun pair) must be specified in the instruction (to ensure that wrong gun is not accidentally specified).

Remedy: Change gun number specified in the instruction to GunA, from GunB. For example, if dual gun pair2 has guns3+4, specify GUN ATTACH[3], not GUN ATTACH[4].

### 3.18.13.468 SVGN-495 DSP numbers must differ for dual gun.

Cause: DSP number is same for gunA and gunB. Dual guns have separate motors, so dsp_num should not be the same.

Remedy: Go from control start to cold start, to automatically update dsp_num.

### 3.18.13.469 SVGN-496 Axis pair is invalid for dual gun.

Cause: The axis mapping is invalid for a dual gun. Index of first axis must be odd (1,3,5,7) and 2nd axis must be adjacent to first axis. Examples of valid axisorder settings for a dual gun are shown below. [7, 8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] [0, 0, 9,10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] [0, 0, 0, 0,11,12, 0, 0, 0] [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,13,14, 0] ^ ^ ^ ^ <— valid indices for first axis.

Remedy: This alarm is a cause code for SVGN-498 and SVGN-499. Refer to the error code for more info.

### 3.18.13.470 SVGN-497 Axis count:%d not equal to gun count:%d

Cause: The axis mapping does not correspond to the gun type (dual/single) selection.

<!-- PDF page 1763 -->

Remedy: This alarm is a cause code for SVGN-498 and SVGN-499. Refer to the error code to determine the next action.

### 3.18.13.471 SVGN-498 Power-up attach/detach cancelled.

Cause: Repower occurred, and $axisorder was invalid or inconsistent with gun setting. Power-up attach/detach was cancelled so gun group is faulted. Refer to cause code for the reason.

Remedy: Go to control start and Check dual/single gun setting. If dual/single gun setting is correct, go to cold start. If dual/single gun setting is incorrect, change gun setting, then go to cold start. Note that axisorder is automatically corrected at cold start or when gun selection changes or if you go to control start config menu and select this equipment. Attach gun(s) if desired, after cold start completes.

### 3.18.13.472 SVGN-499 Axis order cleared for gunchange grp.

Cause: $axisorder was invalid or inconsistent with gun setting Axisorder was automatically cleared to correct this issue; all guns are detached. Refer to cause code for more info.

Remedy: None. An Axisorder error was corrected and guns are detected. Attach gun(s) if desired.

### 3.18.13.473 SVGN-500 Battery must be ON for dual gun change.

Cause: The battery type for gun change is set to OFF.Batteryless dual gun change is not supported.

Remedy: Change battery type to ON.

### 3.18.13.474 SVGN-501 Teach Verify start(%s,%d)

Cause: Teach verification has STARTED for SPOT (or PRESS_MOTN[]) at specified program and line.

Remedy: None. This message is for status info, it is not a problem.

### 3.18.13.475 SVGN-502 Teach Verify end(%s,%d)

Cause: Teach verification has ENDED for SPOT (or PRESS_MOTN[]) at specified program and line.

Remedy: None. This message is for status info, it is not a problem.

<!-- PDF page 1764 -->

### 3.18.13.476 SVGN-503 Teach Verify enable became false.

Cause: Teach verification input was asserted and teach verification started. However, verify enable input became false, so verification cannot proceed.

Remedy: 1. Turn input on and resume to continue with verification OR2. Leave input off and resume to cancel verification. After cancel, Spot will restart at approach and execute normally.

### 3.18.13.477 SVGN-601 Invalid gun number(%d) for sglog

Cause: Value specified in $SGLOGINF.$GUN_NUM was < 1 or > num guns when STARTLOG macro was called.

Remedy: Set valid gun number, before calling STARTLOG macro.

### 3.18.13.478 SVGN-602 Invalid log type(%d) for sglog

Cause: $SGLOGINF.$LOG_TYPE was < 1 or > logtype dimension(default=33) at log start trigger.

Remedy: Set valid value log type, before calling STARTLOG macro.

### 3.18.13.479 SVGN-603 Gun%d Logtyp%d NOT started (Buf1 busy)

Cause: A valid logstart request was received, but system was not done capturing data for previous request (previous request has precedence).

Remedy: Disable one of the log types, or increase time between log requests.

### 3.18.13.480 SVGN-604 Buf1 dropped gun%d log%d idx%d

Cause: Log data was captured and buffer1 was created. However, buffer1 was dropped because buffer2 and buffer3 were full.

Remedy: Decrease log extend time. Disable logging for this logtype, if problem cannot be resolved. Also, see SVGN-605 for info on buffers2, 3. SVGN-604 is posted as a separate alarm (for info) before SVGN-603 is posted.

### 3.18.13.481 SVGN-605 Buf%d Gun%d Log%d Idx%d

Cause: This alarm is cause info for SVGN-603. It is provided to better understand why log was busy, when error occurred.

<!-- PDF page 1765 -->

Remedy: See SVGN-604.

### 3.18.13.482 SVGN-606 Buf3 timout%dms gun%d log%d idx%d

Cause: Log data was captured and file write started, but file write took too long.

Remedy: Increase timeout duration. Decrease log extend time. Disable logging for this logtype, if problem cannot be resolved.

### 3.18.13.483 SVGN-607 Pokcalpt%d TrqErr: %d >= %d

Cause: Spot instruction started to execute, but Poke torque calibration data is invalid: torque data value at point x <= torque data value at point x-1. Pt number and torque values are specified in message.

Remedy: Go to poke schedule screen and perform poke calibration again.

### 3.18.13.484 SVGN-608 Pokcalpt%d AngErr: %.1f >= %.1f

Cause: Spot instruction started to execute, but Poke angle calibration data is invalid: angle data value at point x <= angle data value at point x-1. Pt number and torque values are specified in message.

Remedy: Go to poke schedule screen and perform poke calibration again.

### 3.18.13.485 SVGN-609 Poke schedule measurement incomplete

Cause: Spot instruction started to execute, but poke angle calibration was never performed.

Remedy: Go to poke schedule screen and perform poke calibration.

### 3.18.13.486 SVGN-610 Nominal thick:%.1f MinAllowable:%.1f

Cause: The Measured part thickness is less than the under-thickness limit(mm). The part may be out-of-tolerance. NOTE: This message displays the nominal (expected/programmed) thickness and the under-thickness (MinAllowable) limit.

Remedy: See SVGN-040.

<!-- PDF page 1766 -->

### 3.18.13.487 SVGN-611 Nominal thick:%.1f MaxAllowable:%.1f

Cause: The Measured part thickness is greater than the over-thickness limit(mm). The part may be out-of-tolerance. NOTE: This message displays the nominal (expected/programmed) thickness and the over-thickness (MaxAllowable) limit.

Remedy: See SVGN-040.

### 3.18.13.488 SVGN-612 Dither Compensation: Re-power required

Cause: Dither compensation enable/disable state has changed, and repower is necessary to activate change.

Remedy: Cycle power. This alarm is merely a notification, it is not an abnormal condition.

### 3.18.14 SVTL Alarm Code

### 3.18.14.1 SVTL-001 Axis number does not exist

Cause: Axis number doesn't exist.

Remedy: Make sure axis number is right.

### 3.18.14.2 SVTL-002 Update trq_lim timeout(g:%s)

Cause: Time out while Updating servo parameters.

Remedy: This should only happen in desktop unit or virtual robot. Otherwise, please check alarm log for other errors.

### 3.18.14.3 SVTL-003 Other Servo Tool running

Cause: Servo Tool is active when TP program is executed.

Remedy: Abort the original TP program which activates Servo Tool or execute SERVOTOOL END inst.

### 3.18.14.4 SVTL-004 Torque Limit too small (ID:%s)

Cause: Torque limit used in Servo Tool schedule ID is less than 0.1%.

<!-- PDF page 1767 -->

Remedy: Set torque limit in Servo Tool schedule ID to more than 0.1%.

### 3.18.14.5 SVTL-005 Group number mismatch (ID:%s)

Cause: Group number in Servo Tool schedule ID does not match with current TP program's group mask.

Remedy: Use group number 0 in Servo Tool schedule or change TP program's group mask.

### 3.18.14.6 SVTL-006 No contact or dest. reaches

Cause: The destination position has been reached before contact detected.

Remedy: Make sure part is present or increase torque limit.

### 3.18.14.7 SVTL-007 Paused while detecting part

Cause: Program is paused while detecting part.

Remedy: Not pause program while part detecting.

### 3.18.14.8 SVTL-008 Continue paused detection

Cause: Program continues after pause while detecting.

Remedy: Not pause program while part detecting.

### 3.18.14.9 SVTL-009 Servo Tool is active

Cause: Zero group mask program is running when Servo Tool is active.

Remedy: This is warning only

### 3.18.14.10 SVTL-010 Detecting timeout

Cause: Time out occured while detecting part and coasting to the destination position.

Remedy: Make sure part present, increase torque limit, or increase time out value.

<!-- PDF page 1768 -->

### 3.18.14.11 SVTL-011 Axis Limit (G:%d A:%d U:%d)

Cause: Software axis limit occurred while axis is under low torque for G: group, A: axis, and U: upper or lower limit.

Remedy: This is a warning to remind the axis may be pushed out of

### 3.18.14.12 SVTL-012 Cannot update position

Cause: forward kinematics failed or unknown position type of taught points

Remedy: Change offset value from menu

### 3.18.14.13 SVTL-013 Axis not moving

Cause: the axis ServoTool enabled was not moving before motion line finished.

Remedy: increase torque limit or

### 3.18.15 SYST Alarm Code

### 3.18.15.1 SYST-001 HOLD button is being pressed

Cause: You attempted an operation while the hold button (input) is pressed.

Remedy: Clear the hold button (input), and try the same operation.

### 3.18.15.2 SYST-002 HOLD is locked by program

Cause: Meaning The condition that the robot is being held is locked by the program, and it could not be cleared. If a HOLD statement is executed in a KAREL program, the held condition can only be cleared by the same program using the UNHOLD statement/action, or by aborting the program. If a motion is attempted in such condition, this error message is displayed.

Remedy: Wait until the UNHOLD statement is executed by the KAREL program, or abort the KAREL program.

### 3.18.15.3 SYST-003 TP is enabled

Cause: The attempted operation could not be done because the teach pendant is enabled.

<!-- PDF page 1769 -->

Remedy: Disable the teach pendant, and try the same operation again.

### 3.18.15.4 SYST-004 SOP is enabled

Cause: The attempted operation could not be done because the System Operator Panel is enabled.

Remedy: Turn the REMOTE switch on the SOP to REMOTE side, and try the same operation again.

### 3.18.15.5 SYST-005 UOP is the master device

Cause: The attempted operation could not be done because the User Operator Panel is enabled.

Remedy: Set the remote/local operation mode to Local in the system configuration screen (if the operation is attempted from the SOP), or set the $RMT_MASTER system variable correctly. Refer to the Software Reference Manual, Chapter 2 System Variables, for more information on system variables. Set the variable to one of the following values: 0:User Operator, 1:CRT/KB, 2:Host computer, 3:Remote device none, 4:RobotLink master

### 3.18.15.6 SYST-006 KCL is the master device

Cause: The attempted operation could not be done because KCL is the master device.

Remedy: Set the remote/local operation mode to Local in the system configuration screen (if the operation is attempted from the SOP), or set the $RMT_MASTER system variable correctly. Refer to the Software Reference Manual, Chapter 2 System Variables, for more information on system variables. Set the variable to one of the following values: 0:User Operator Panel, 1:CRT/KB, 2:Host computer, 3:Remote device none, 4:RobotLink master

### 3.18.15.7 SYST-007 NETWORK is the master device

Cause: The attempted operation could not be done because the NETWORK command processor is the master device.

Remedy: Set the remote/local operation mode to Local in the system configuration screen (if the operation is attempted from the SOP), or set the $RMT_MASTER system variable correctly. Refer to the Software Reference Manual, Chapter 2 System Variables, for more information on system variables. Set the variable to one of the following values: 0:User Operator Panel, 1:CRT/KB, 2:Host computer, 3:Remote device none, 4:RobotLink master

<!-- PDF page 1770 -->

### 3.18.15.8 SYST-008 Nothing is the master device

Cause: The system variable $RMT_MASTER is set to disable all devices. Therefore, no remote device can issue motion.

Remedy: Set the remote/local operation mode to Local in the system configuration screen (if the operation is attempted from the SOP), or set the $RMT_MASTER system variable correctly. Refer to the Software Reference Manual, Chapter 2 System Variables, for more information on system variables. Set the variable to one of the following values: 0:User Operator Panel, 1:CRT/KB, 2:Host computer, 3:Remote device none, 4:RobotLink master

### 3.18.15.9 SYST-009 Safety Fence open

Cause: The attempted operation could not be done because the safety fence is open.

Remedy: Close the safety fence, and try the same operation again.

### 3.18.15.10 SYST-010 Max num task reached

Cause: The number of task has reached the maximum.

Remedy: Abort one of the running task.

### 3.18.15.11 SYST-011 Failed to run task

Cause: The system has failed to run the program.

Remedy: Refer to the error cause code. Use MENU to display the Alarm Log screen.

### 3.18.15.12 SYST-012 Not in remote

Cause: Remote condition is not satisfied.

Remedy: Turn the remote switch on.

### 3.18.15.13 SYST-013 Invalid program number

Cause: The specified PNS number is not in the range of 1 to 9999.

Remedy: Specify correct program number.

<!-- PDF page 1771 -->

### 3.18.15.14 SYST-014 Program select failed

Cause: PNS operation has failed by some reason.

Remedy: Refer to the error cause code. Use MENU to display the Alarm Log screen.

### 3.18.15.15 SYST-015 Robot Service Request failed

Cause: RSR operation has failed by some reason.

Remedy: Refer to the error cause code. Use MENU to display the Alarm Log screen.

### 3.18.15.16 SYST-016 ENBL signal is off

Cause: ENBL signal in UOP is off

Remedy: Set ENBL signal ON

### 3.18.15.17 SYST-017 Single step operation effective

Cause: Single step operation is effective

Remedy: Disable single step switch

### 3.18.15.18 SYST-018 Continuing from different line

Cause: Attempt to continue program from different line from paused line

Remedy: Respond YES or NO in the prompt box on at the teach pendant

### 3.18.15.19 SYST-019 Program not selected

Cause: Program has not been selected

Remedy: Select a program from the program select menu on the teach pendant, or using PNS

### 3.18.15.20 SYST-020 Program not verified by PNS

Cause: The program specified by PNS is different from the currently selected program. This error occurs in Mate controllers only.

<!-- PDF page 1772 -->

**Remedy:** Select a correct program from the program select menu on the teach pendant.

### **3.18.15.21 SYST-021 System not ready, press reset**

**Cause:** An error has been detected by the system

**Remedy:** Press RESET to clear error condition

### **3.18.15.22 SYST-022 PNS not zero, cannot continue**

**Cause:** The paused program cannot be continued if the PNS input ports are not zero. This error occurs in Mate controllers only.

**Remedy:** Set all PNS input ports to OFF.

### **3.18.15.23 SYST-023 Teach Pendant communication error**

**Cause:** A communication cable is broken.

**Remedy:** Check the teach pendant cable. Replace the cable if necessary.

### **3.18.15.24 SYST-024 PNSTROBE is OFF. Cannot start exec**

**Cause:** Because PNSTROBE is off, prod_start could not be processed

**Remedy:** Set PNSTROBE input to ON

### **3.18.15.25 SYST-025 Teach Pendant is different type**

**Cause:** The type of teach pendant being connected, is different from the one that was disconnected.

**Remedy:** Connect the same type of teach pendant as disconnected.

### **3.18.15.26 SYST-026 System normal power up**

**Cause:** System has executed normal power startup

**Remedy:** This is just a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

<!-- PDF page 1773 -->

### 3.18.15.27 SYST-027 HOT start failed (Error:%d)

Cause: HOT start has failed for one of the following reasons: 1. Power failed during system start up. 2. Flash ROM module was changed. 3. A run-time error occurred. 4. System internal error 1. 5. System internal error 2.

Remedy: COLD start is selected automatically.

### 3.18.15.28 SYST-028 (%s) Program timed out

Cause: $PWR_HOT,$PWR_SEMI program has been aborted by the system due to time out (40sec)

Remedy: Decrease program size so that it can be executed within the time out limit

### 3.18.15.29 SYST-029 Robot was connected (Group:%d)

Cause: The connect/isolate key was turn to the connect side

Remedy: This is just a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

### 3.18.15.30 SYST-030 Robot was isolated (Group:%d)

Cause: The connect/isolate key was turn to the isolate side

Remedy: This is just a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

### 3.18.15.31 SYST-031 F-ROM parity

Cause: An error has occurred accessing F-ROM

Remedy: Perform a cold start: 1. Turn off the robot. 2. On the teach pendant, press and hold the SHIFT and RESET keys. 3. While still pressing the SHIFT and RESET keys, turn on the robot. If the error is not cleared, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

### 3.18.15.32 SYST-032 ENBL signal from UOP is lost

Cause: ENBL input signal from UOP is lost

Remedy: Determine and correct the cause of loss of this signal.

<!-- PDF page 1774 -->

# **3.18.15.33 SYST-033 SFSPD signal from UOP is lost**

**Cause:** SFSPD input signal from UOP is lost

**Remedy:** Determine and correct the cause of loss of this signal.

# **3.18.15.34 SYST-034 HOLD signal from SOP/UOP is lost**

**Cause:** HOLD input signal from SOP/UOP is lost

**Remedy:** Determine and correct the cause of loss of this signal.

# **3.18.15.35 SYST-035 Low or No Battery Power on MAIN**

**Cause:** Battery in PSU board is low in power.

**Remedy:** Replace the Old Battery with a new battery of same kind.

# **3.18.15.36 SYST-036 Semi power failure recovery**

**Cause:** System did semi-hot start

**Remedy:** This is just a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

# **3.18.15.37 SYST-037 Key switch broken**

**Cause:** Improper input from Key switch

**Remedy:** Please fix the CE Sign key switch

# **3.18.15.38 SYST-038 Operation mode T1 Selected**

**Cause:** Operation mode T1 Selected

**Remedy:** This is just a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

# **3.18.15.39 SYST-039 Operation mode T2 Selected**

**Cause:** Operation mode T2 Selected

**Remedy:** This is just a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

### 3.18.15.40 SYST-040 Operation mode AUTO Selected

Cause: Operation mode AUTO Selected

Remedy: This is just a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

### 3.18.15.41 SYST-041 Ovrd Select could not ENABLED

Cause: DI index is invalid

Remedy: Please set valid DI index

### 3.18.15.42 SYST-042 DEADMAN defeated

Cause: The mode switch was changed from T1 or T2 mode to AUTO mode and the DEADMAN was already pressed. The DEADMAN must be released when switching to AUTO mode

Remedy: Release the DEADMAN and press RESET.

### 3.18.15.43 SYST-043 TP disabled in T1/T2 mode

Cause: The mode selector is in T1 or T2 and the TP ON/OFF switch is in the OFF position

Remedy: Turn the TP ON/OFF switch to ON. Press RESET.

### 3.18.15.44 SYST-044 (Abnormal) TP disabled in T1/T2 mode

Cause: The mode selector is in T1 or T2 and the TP ON/OFF switch is in the OFF position and SVON is ON. This is an abnormal condition.

Remedy: Call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

### 3.18.15.45 SYST-045 TP enabled in AUTO mode

Cause: The mode selector is in AUTO and the TP ON/OFF switch is in the ON position

Remedy: Turn the TP ON/OFF switch to OFF. Press RESET.

<!-- PDF page 1776 -->

### 3.18.15.46 SYST-046 Control Reliable/CE Mark config mismatch

Cause: Either 1.Control Reliable or CE Mark hardware exists but the CR or CE Mark option has not been loaded,or 2.The Control Reliable/CE Mark option has been loaded but the hardware is not available.

Remedy: If the Control Reliable/CE Mark option has not been loaded, load the Control Reliable/ CE Mark option. If it has been loaded then this is a system without the Control Reliable/ CE Mark hardware and the system must be totally reloaded WITHOUT the Control Reliable/CE Mark option.

### 3.18.15.47 SYST-047 Continuing from distant position

Cause: Attempt to continue program from distant position from stopped position.

Remedy: Respond ABORT or CONTINUE in the prompt box on at the teach pendant

### 3.18.15.48 SYST-048 NECALC couldn't get work memory

Cause: OS couldn't give NECALC soft part enough memory

Remedy: Please increase Controller's memory

### 3.18.15.49 SYST-049 SFCALC couldn't get work memory

Cause: OS couldn't give SFCALC soft part enough memory

Remedy: Please increase Controller's memory

### 3.18.15.50 SYST-050 Invalid time in trigger request

Cause: Invalid time used in TG request

Remedy: Time must be less than 6,000,000 us

### 3.18.15.51 SYST-051 SYTG overrun: %d %d %x %d %d

Cause: Excessive time iin trigger routines First number indicates event routine (1) or scan routine (2). Second number indicates individual overrun (1) or excessive cumative CPU use (2). Third number: event number(hexadecimal) or scan routine address Fourth number: limit (microseconds or 100ths of one pct) Fifth number: time used (microseconds or 100ths of one pct)

<!-- PDF page 1777 -->

Remedy: Event or scan routine need to be made more efficient, scan rate reduced, or system variable values increased to permit more CPU usage.

### 3.18.15.52 SYST-052 Trigger slot already used: %d

Cause: Specified entry already used

Remedy: Use cancel request to delete old entry

### 3.18.15.53 SYST-053 Invalid fast_DIN no: %d

Cause: Specified Fast-DIN number is invalid

Remedy: Use Valid Fast-DIN

### 3.18.15.54 SYST-054 Event-ID already used: %d

Cause: Specified event ID already in use

Remedy: Use unique event ID or cancel previous request

### 3.18.15.55 SYST-055 Event-ID not found: %d

Cause: Specified event ID is not presently in use

Remedy: Check event ID

### 3.18.15.56 SYST-056 Scan routine list full

Cause: A call to syscnrtn was made when the scan list was full. A maximum of 10 scan routines, including the standard table scanning routine, may be active at one time.

Remedy: Either cancel scan routines that are no longer needed or combine scan routines

### 3.18.15.57 SYST-057 Illegal interval

Cause: The interval parameter in a call to syscnrtn was greater than 1000000 (1 second).

Remedy: Use a value in the range 1-1000000

<!-- PDF page 1778 -->

### 3.18.15.58 SYST-058 Duplicate scan routine

Cause: syscnrtn was called specifying a routine and data_p that is already being scanned

Remedy: Don't request the same rtn/data_p twice

### 3.18.15.59 SYST-059 Scan routine not active

Cause: syclclsc was called with a routine and data_p that that does not match any active scans

Remedy: Don't cancel a non-existent scan

### 3.18.15.60 SYST-060 Duplicate cond/act table

Cause: syaddtbl called with pointer to table that is already in the scan list

Remedy: Add table only once

### 3.18.15.61 SYST-061 Scan table list full

Cause: syaddtbl called when all 10 condition/action table slots are already in use

Remedy: Cancel tables that are no longer needed or combine tables.

### 3.18.15.62 SYST-062 Scan table not active

Cause: sycncltb called with cond/act table that is not active.

Remedy: Check for duplicate sycncltb call or wrong table pointer

### 3.18.15.63 SYST-063 Scan time record seq error

Cause: System error: consecutive time interval start calls

Remedy: Contact FANUC America Corporation with information on events leading up to error

### 3.18.15.64 SYST-064 Bad scan table data

Cause: System error: Invalid data in scan table The following can result in this error: Too many cond/action sets (max = 10) Invalid condition code Invalid action code Too many actions (max = 3)

<!-- PDF page 1779 -->

Remedy: Contact FANUC America Corporation with information on events leading up to error

### 3.18.15.65 SYST-065 SFCALC overrun

Cause: SFCALC task can't get enough MPU power.

Remedy: Please reduce some software options or disable some motion groups which had been enabled.

### 3.18.15.66 SYST-066 Teach Pendant communication error

Cause: Communication with the advanced Teach Pendant was interrupted.

Remedy: Too much communication may have caused the interrupt. Check the teach pendant cable. Replace the cable if necessary.

### 3.18.15.67 SYST-067 Panel HSSB disconnect

Cause: Panel HSSB communication is disconnected.

Remedy: Check panel HSSB hardware connection.

### 3.18.15.68 SYST-069 Program number out of range

Cause: The selected style number is zero or greater than the size of the style table.

Remedy: Select a valid style number, or adjust the size of the table.

### 3.18.15.69 SYST-070 No program name in table

Cause: There is no program name in the style table.

Remedy: Put a valid program name in the proper place in the style table.

### 3.18.15.70 SYST-071 Program not found

Cause: The selected style program does not exist on the controller.

Remedy: Create a program for the style, or put a valid program name in the style table.

<!-- PDF page 1780 -->

### 3.18.15.71 SYST-072 Program not enabled

Cause: The selected style program is not enabled.

Remedy: Set the VALID field to YES in the style table.

### 3.18.15.72 SYST-073 Manual selection mismatch

Cause: The style input does not match the manually selected style.

Remedy: The PLC must send a style code that matches the manual selection.

### 3.18.15.73 SYST-074 Karel shell failed

Cause: Communications with the Karel shell extension failed.

Remedy: Cold start the controller.

### 3.18.15.74 SYST-075 Shell init failure

Cause: The shell was unable to start due to resource allocation failures.

Remedy: Cold start the controller.

### 3.18.15.75 SYST-076 Shell condition setup failure

Cause: The shell could not set up its required condition handlers.

Remedy: Cold start the controller.

### 3.18.15.76 SYST-077 Entered INTERLOCK mode

Cause: The controller is interlocked with the PLC

Remedy: This is an informational message. There is no error.

### 3.18.15.77 SYST-078 Entered ISOLATE mode

Cause: The controller is isolated from PLC control.

Remedy: This is an informational message. There is no error

<!-- PDF page 1781 -->

### 3.18.15.78 SYST-079 Startup check failed

Cause: One or more of the pre-startup system checks failed.

Remedy: Look for a previous message that indicates exactly which check failed and take corrective action.

### 3.18.15.79 SYST-080 Fault must be reset

Cause: The system is in a faulted state.

Remedy: Reset the fault before trying the operation again.

### 3.18.15.80 SYST-081 Not at home position

Cause: The program can not start because the robot is not at the defined home position.

Remedy: Move the robot to the home position.

### 3.18.15.81 SYST-082 Not within resume tolerance

Cause: The program can not be resumed because the robot has been moved from the position on the path where it stopped.

Remedy: Jog the robot back to the correct position.

### 3.18.15.82 SYST-083 I/O is simulated

Cause: One or more I/O points are simulated.

Remedy: Unsimulate all I/O before trying to start the program.

### 3.18.15.83 SYST-084 I/O forced unsimulated

Cause: The system has forced all I/O to be unsimulated.

Remedy: This is an informational message.

### 3.18.15.84 SYST-085 Gen override not 100%

Cause: The general speed override is not 100%

<!-- PDF page 1782 -->

Remedy: Set the override to 100%.

### 3.18.15.85 SYST-086 Gen override forced to 100%

Cause: The system has forced the general speed override to 100%

Remedy: This is an informational message.

### 3.18.15.86 SYST-087 Prog override not 100%

Cause: The program override is not 100%.

Remedy: Set the override to 100%.

### 3.18.15.87 SYST-088 Prog override forced to 100%

Cause: The system has forced the program speed override to 100%.

Remedy: This is an informational message.

### 3.18.15.88 SYST-089 Machine lock on

Cause: The machine lock is on, motion can not occur.

Remedy: Turn off the machine lock.

### 3.18.15.89 SYST-090 Machine lock forced off

Cause: The system has forced machine lock to the off state.

Remedy: This is an informational message.

### 3.18.15.90 SYST-091 Single step active

Cause: The program is in single-step mode.

Remedy: Take the system out of single-step mode.

<!-- PDF page 1783 -->

### 3.18.15.91 SYST-092 Single step forced off

Cause: The system has forced single-stepping to be off.

Remedy: This is an informational message.

### 3.18.15.92 SYST-093 Process not ready

Cause: The program can not start because the process is not ready.

Remedy: Make the process equipment ready for running a program.

### 3.18.15.93 SYST-094 Process forced ready

Cause: The system has forced the process equipment to the ready state.

Remedy: This is an informational message.

### 3.18.15.94 SYST-095 Remote diagnose internal error

Cause: An internal error occurred with the remote diagnosis function.

Remedy: Internal error

### 3.18.15.95 SYST-096 Designated task is not valid

Cause: A task specified by the PC is not correct.

Remedy: Check the remote diagnosis software on the PC.

### 3.18.15.96 SYST-097 Fail to initialize Modem

Cause: Modem initialization failed.

Remedy: Check if a modem is installed. Check the modem type setting.

### 3.18.15.97 SYST-098 Card Modem is removed

Cause: The modem card is removed during communication.

<!-- PDF page 1784 -->

Remedy: Reinsert the modem card, then restart the remote diagnosis function. Check if the modem card is inserted into the PCMCIA slot correctly.

### 3.18.15.98 SYST-099 Card Modem is not responded

Cause: There is no response from the modem card.

Remedy: Check if a modem card is inserted correctly. Check the mode card.

### 3.18.15.99 SYST-100 DSR in Modem OFF

Cause: DSR was turned off during communication.

Remedy: Check the connection between Robot and the modem. If a modem card is used, check if the modem card is not destroyed and if the modem card is inserted correctly.

### 3.18.15.100 SYST-101 Connection is stopped

Cause: The line was disconnected.

Remedy: Check the telephone line.

### 3.18.15.101 SYST-102 HDI not recorded

Cause: Internal Error in Remote Diagnose function.

Remedy: Internal error

### 3.18.15.105 SYST-106 Gen override ignored

### 3.18.15.106 SYST-107 Prog override ignored

### 3.18.15.107 SYST-108 Machine lock ignored

Cause: User bypassed machine lock at program startup.

### 3.18.15.108 SYST-109 Single step ignored

Cause: User bypassed single-step condition at program startup.

Remedy: None needed - warning only.

### 3.18.15.109 SYST-110 Process ready ignored

### 3.18.15.110 SYST-111 No home pos defined

Cause: The decision code input group, which is required with the current program selection options, has not been defined.

Cause: The decision code output group, which is required with the current program selection options, has not been defined.

Cause: The in-cycle output, which is required with the current program selection options, has not been defined.

Cause: The task_OK output, which is required with the current program selection options, has not been defined.
