### 3.18.15.129 SYST-130 Program still running

Cause: The shell is already running an active program.

Remedy: Finish or abort the current program before requesting a new program selection.

### 3.18.15.130 SYST-131 Invalid manual style request

Cause: The manual style request cannot be done. There is also a secondary error posted that gives the reason.

Remedy: Examine the secondary error message.

### 3.18.15.131 SYST-132 Manual request timed out

Cause: The specified manual style was not requested by the PLC within the allowable time period.

Remedy: Determine why the PLC did not respond to the request, or increase the timeout value.

### 3.18.15.132 SYST-133 System trigger request early

Cause: A request for a system trigger function (scan routine, etc) was made before the tables for these are initialized.

Remedy: Defer any of these requests until late in the cold-start process

<!-- PDF page 1790 -->

### 3.18.15.133 SYST-134 Max. freq. exceeded ch.: %d

Cause: A frequency input connected to one of the HDI inputs momentarily or for an extended time had a frequency exceeding the setting for the maximum. The channel or input number is indicated in the alarm text.

Remedy: Reduce or eliminate the noise on the signal with additional grounding or shielding. If the frequency dip switch setting on the HDI Pulse Module is for the low range (640 Hz) and normal input frequencies will be above this, change the settings. Change the dip switch setting to the high range (1000 Hz) and the system variable $FQINT_SETUP[n].$FREQ_MAX_AL to 1020. If the frequency dip switch setting on the HDI Pulse Module is for the high range (1000 Hz) and normal input frequencies will always be below the low range change the setting to the low range. If the device providing the frequency (a flow meter for example) is providing frequencies above 1000 Hz, either change settings on the meter or change the type of meter so that the frequency provided is reduced. To disable this alarm, change the setting of the system variable $FQINT_SETUP[n].$FREQ_MAX_AL to 1200 if using the HDI Pulse Module or to 0 otherwise.

### 3.18.15.134 SYST-135 Invalid Clock, Please Reset

Cause: The system clock has an invalid time. The clock may not have been set.

Remedy: Reset the system Clock using the SYSTEM Clock TP page

### 3.18.15.135 SYST-136 System Time was reset

Cause: The system clock was reset by either an Operator or by the SNTP protocol, if SNTP is enabled.

Remedy: Check the system Clock using the SYSTEM Clock teach pendant screen.

### 3.18.15.136 SYST-137 Device not found

Cause: The requested device is not installed on the motherboard.

Remedy: Request only valid devices.

### 3.18.15.137 SYST-138 Motherboard not installed

Cause: The specified motherboard is not installed.

Remedy: Specify only installed motherboards.

<!-- PDF page 1791 -->

### 3.18.15.138 SYST-139 Invalid motherboard request

Cause: The specified motherboard index is not a valid value.

Remedy: This is a programming error. Specify only index 0 or 1

### 3.18.15.139 SYST-140 Invalid IRQ specified

Cause: An invalid interrupt number was specified by the device driver.

Remedy: Specify an IRQ from 3 through 7 only.

### 3.18.15.140 SYST-141 BMON was updated

Cause: BMON was automatically updated because of a newer version.

Remedy: Check BMON version.

### 3.18.15.141 SYST-142 ABS time in sytmrev in past

Cause: The time specified for a timed event has already passed The event will trigger immediately

### 3.18.15.142 SYST-143 pkt_data_size too big

Cause: pkt_data_size parameter in syinpev_gen call is too big.

### 3.18.15.143 SYST-144 Bad DO specified by %s

Cause: Invalid or unassigned DOUT number specified in the indicated system variable.

### 3.18.15.144 SYST-145 DO specified by %s OFFLINE

Cause: DOUT specified in the indicated system variable is Off-line.

<!-- PDF page 1792 -->

Remedy: Set the device to which the DOUT is assigned On-line.

### 3.18.15.145 SYST-146 n_pkts invalid

Cause: n_pkts_parameter in syinpev_gen call is invalid.

Remedy: Use value in the range of 1 to 20, or zero if evnt_rtn_2 not used

### 3.18.15.146 SYST-148 Dynamic Brake is Disabled

Cause: Dynamic Brake is disabled by dynamic brake release request signal (DI[$DYN_BRK.$DI_IDX]).

Remedy: If you would like to turn on servo, please turn off dynamic brake release request signal.

### 3.18.15.147 SYST-149 Dynamic Brake is Enabled

Cause: Dynamic Brake is enabled because dynamic brake release request is turned off.

Remedy: It is message only.

### 3.18.15.148 SYST-150 Cursor is not on line 1

### 3.18.15.149 SYST-151 Start again (%s, %d)

Cause: After the program is started except from the 1st line, respond YES in the prompt box on at the teach pendant.

### 3.18.15.150 SYST-152 Cannot force DO's in AUTO mode

Cause: Attempt to force output signal while controller is in AUTO mode

Remedy: Exit AUTO mode before doing this operation

<!-- PDF page 1793 -->

### 3.18.15.151 SYST-153 Cannot SIM/UNSIM DO's in AUTO mode

Cause: Attempt to force output signal while controller is in AUTO mode

Remedy: Exit AUTO mode before doing this operation

### 3.18.15.152 SYST-154 No start in ISOLATE/BYPASS mode

Cause: Production start received when controller is in ISOLATE or BYPASS mode

### 3.18.15.153 SYST-156 Unknown hard ware

Cause: This PCB is not used on this controller.

Remedy: Mount the correct PCB.

### 3.18.15.154 SYST-157 CE/RIA software does not exist

Cause: CE/RIA software does not exist in this controller.

### 3.18.15.155 SYST-158 Robot cannot move in T2 mode

### 3.18.15.156 SYST-160 Value output to GO %d out of limit

### 3.18.15.157 SYST-161 Cannot start Remote diagnostic

### 3.18.15.158 SYST-162 Servo On during Remote diagnostic

Cause: The servo is turned on during remote diagnostics.

### 3.18.15.159 SYST-163 Cannot operate IO during Remote diagnostic

### 3.18.15.160 SYST-164 Teach Pendant communication error

### 3.18.15.161 SYST-165 TP intermittent communication error

### 3.18.15.162 SYST-166 TP intermittent communication error

### 3.18.15.163 SYST-168 Robot(G:%d) is isolated

### 3.18.15.166 SYST-171 S/W Reg. expires in %d days

### 3.18.15.167 SYST-172 S/W Registration has expired

### 3.18.15.168 SYST-173 See S/W Reg Screen (STATUS)

Remedy: This message is for reference only. No action is required.

### 3.18.15.172 SYST-177 RobotLink master is the master

Cause: The attempted operation could not be done because the robot is under control of the RobotLink Master robot.

Remedy: Set the remote/local operation mode to Local in the system configuration screen (if the operation is attempted from the SOP), or set the $RMT_MASTER system variable correctly.

### 3.18.15.173 SYST-188 book(%d) was not created

Cause: The book of operation logbook was not created.

Remedy: Reduce the number of books or $LOG_BUFF[ ].$SIZE to allocate book.

### 3.18.15.174 SYST-189 There is no book

Cause: There is no book of operation logbook.

Remedy: None.

### 3.18.15.175 SYST-195 TP (on Rob#%d) enabled in T2 mode

Cause: More than one teach pendant is enabled while in T2 mode within the multi-arm ring.

Remedy: Disable the teach pendant which is not being used for the desired operation.

<!-- PDF page 1797 -->

### 3.18.15.176 SYST-196 Enabled TP exists (H%x)

Cause: The desired operation could not be performed because teach pendants were enabled within the multi-arm ring.

Remedy: Disable the teach pendants which are not being used for the desired operation.

### 3.18.15.177 SYST-197 Multi-arm Watchdog alarm

Cause: The master robot did not receive a heartbeat message from the slave robots within the time specified by the $rkmashconf.$heartbt_tmo system variable.

Remedy: Check and repair any broken network connections.

### 3.18.15.178 SYST-198 Slave Robot Not Ready

Cause: Some slave robots are not ready to run a program.

Remedy: All slave robots have Auto/T1/T2 switch to be AUTO. $RMT_MASTER system variable must be 4 (Robot Link). Verify the system variable $RMT_MASTER is set to 4 on all slave robots.

### 3.18.15.179 SYST-199 Def Prog NOT change (TP disbl)

Cause: The selected robot program could not be changed because the robot has been defined as a slave to a master robot, and the teach pendant is disabled.

Remedy: If you are selecting the program using a teach pendant, enable the teach pendant to select a different program name.

### 3.18.15.180 SYST-200 Only Master TP may FWD/BWD

Cause: Only the teach pendant on the master robot can perform the SHIFT-FWD/BWD operation for multi-arm programs.

Remedy: Use the teach pendant on the master robot to perform the SHIFT-FWD/BWD operation.

### 3.18.15.181 SYST-201 Master mismatch

Cause: The master robot number does not match with the one specified in the slave header.

Remedy: Verify the master robot number in the slave program header.

<!-- PDF page 1798 -->

### 3.18.15.182 SYST-202 Incorrect $rmt_master on Slave robot

Cause: One or more of the specified slave robots does not accept the command from the master robot because of $rmt_master system variable value.

Remedy: Verify that the system variable $RMT_MASTER is set to 4 on all slave robots.

### 3.18.15.183 SYST-203 Robot #%d has become online

Cause: This is a notification that a robot has been successfully added to the robot link network as a slave robot.

Remedy: None.

### 3.18.15.184 SYST-204 Multi Program start in progress

Cause: The program run sequence is still in progress.

Remedy: Wait until the previous request is taken care of before you continue.

### 3.18.15.185 SYST-205 NO action specified

Cause: The teach pendant FWD or BWD key was pressed without also pressing the SHIFT key.

Remedy: Press the SHIFT key in addition to pressing the FWD or BWD key.

### 3.18.15.186 SYST-206 Operation canceled by RESET key

Cause: The operation was canceled by pressing the RESET key.

Remedy: None.

### 3.18.15.187 SYST-207 Message posted at Rob#%d (%s)

Cause: An error message has been posted on another robot.

Remedy: Display the error history screen of the robot where the error was posted, and perform the remedy stated in the error message.

<!-- PDF page 1799 -->

### 3.18.15.188 SYST-208 Feature NOT supported

Cause: The attempted operation is not supported. For example, you tried to run separate programs for dual-arm robots.

Remedy: Be sure to perform only the supported operations.

### 3.18.15.189 SYST-210 Only one Family program on Slave Controller

Cause: The attempted operation is not supported. No more than one family program is allowed on a slave controller.

Remedy: Create a new set of programs with one family program on each a controller.

### 3.18.15.190 SYST-211 Comm processor Time-out error

Cause: The communications processor did not respond within the specified time-out limit.

Remedy: Turn off the controller and then turn it on again. If the alarm persists document the events that led to the error, and call your FANUC technical representative.

### 3.18.15.191 SYST-212 Need to apply to DCS param

Cause: Mastering data or robot parameters are changed, but they are not applied to the DCS parameter.

Remedy: Press F3(APPLY) in the DCS menu.

### 3.18.15.192 SYST-213 User power cycle

Cause: A user cycled power from the function menu.

Remedy: None.

### 3.18.15.193 SYST-214 DCS ESTOP

Cause: A DCS ESTOP occurred. This occurs only when $DCS_CFG.$TEST_PARAM1 bit 0 is 1.

Remedy: Set $DCS_CFG.$TEST_PARAM1 to 0.

<!-- PDF page 1800 -->

### 3.18.15.194 SYST-215 DCS CSTOP

Cause: A DCS ESTOP occurred. This occurs only when $DCS_CFG.$TEST_PARAM1 bit 0 is 1.

Remedy: Set $DCS_CFG.$TEST_PARAM1 to 0.

### 3.18.15.195 SYST-216 DCS DCSALM

Cause: A DCS DCSALM occurred. This occurs only when $DCS_CFG.$TEST_PARAM1 bit 0 is 1.

Remedy: Set $DCS_CFG.$TEST_PARAM1 to 0.

### 3.18.15.196 SYST-217 DCS pos./speed is not available

Cause: The DCS position/speed process setting is set to ENABLE, when the hardware is not DCS type or the DCS option is not loaded.

Remedy: Set the DCS position/speed process to DISABLE, or load the DCS option, or change the hardware to DCS type.

### 3.18.15.197 SYST-218 DCS Unavailable robot model G:%x Hex

Cause: The Dual Check Safety Position/Speed Check Function option is loaded, but this robot model is not supported.

Remedy: Delete the Dual Check Safety Position/Speed check function option. This alarm can be cleared by setting $DCS_CFG.$SYS_PARAM to 1, but in this case, Position/Speed check function can not be used.

### 3.18.15.198 SYST-219 Need to verify DCS param (%d)

Cause: When 'Position/Speed process' is enabled, backup files are loaded and DCS parameter is changed. The meaning of 'i' is the following.

- 1 : Image backup is loaded.
- 2 : SYSVARS.SV is loaded and DCS parameter is changed.
- 4 : SYSVARS.SV is loaded and DCS parameter for robot setting is changed.
- 8 : SYSMAST.SV is loaded and DCS parameter in mastering parameter for DCS is changed.
- 16 : SYSPASS.SV is loaded and code number for DCS parameter is changed.

<!-- PDF page 1801 -->

Remedy: Check the setting in DCS menu, and do the VERIFY operation in the DCS top menu.

### 3.18.15.199 SYST-220 Sync Time-out error

Cause: The process synchronization condition was not satisfied within the specified time-out limit.

Remedy:

1. Check the program logic (seq_id inconsistency, etc.)
2. Use a longer time-out limit (in the sync schedule).

### 3.18.15.200 SYST-221 Sync Schedule mismatch

Cause: The sync schedule does not match between robots.

Remedy:

1. Make sure same schedule number is used in the program between robots.
2. Make sure the schedule content (robot mask, etc.) is the same between robots.

### 3.18.15.201 SYST-222 Image backup succeeded

Cause: Image backup was successful.

Remedy: None.

### 3.18.15.202 SYST-223 Image backup failed(0x%x)

Cause: Image backup failed.

Remedy: 0x%x shows the cause of the failure. Find the definition in the list below. Remove the cause of the failure and try the backup again.

- 0x%x Cause and remedy
- 0x1 This isn't used.
- 0x2 Memory allocation failed. Call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.
- 0x3 Information in FROM cannot be acquired. Call your FANUC technical representatiCve.
- 0x4 Make sure there is enough free space on the MC. Make sure a FLASH ATA card is inserted in the MC card slot.

<!-- PDF page 1802 -->

- 0x5 Controller could not open FROM***.IMG. Destination device might be broken.
- 0x6 Controller could not read FROM. FROM module or main board FROM might be broken.
- 0x7 Controller could not write data to FROM***.IMG. Destination device might be broken.
- 0x8 Controller could not close FROM***.IMG. The following are possible causes:

- There are already backup files on the destination device and they are write-protected.
- MC was removed during backup.
- Communication was disconnected during backup to TFTP server.
- TFTP server is not running.

- 0x9 Make sure there is enough free space on MC. Make sure FLASH ATA card is inserted to MC card slot.
- 0xa Controller cannot open SRAM***.IMG. Destination device might be broken.
- 0xb Controller could not write data to SRAM***.IMG. Destination device might be broken.
- 0xc Controller could not close SRAM***.IMG. The following are possible causes:

- There are already backup files on the destination device and they are write-protected.
- MC was removed during backup.
- Communication was disconnected during backup to TFTP server.
- TFTP server is not running.

- 0xd File for internal use may be broken. Try the backup again.
- 0xe File for internal use may be broken. Try the backup again.
- 0xf After power was cycled by image backup function, a backup file was found on the MC. This happens if power is turned off during automatic image backup. Retry backup from file screen again.
- 0x20 Initialization of network failed. Confirm wiring and BOOTP server is running.

### 3.18.15.203 SYST-230 RCRON: Action successful

Cause: RCRON command was executed.

Remedy: This notification can be disabled by setting the system variable $RCRON.$POST_OK to FALSE.

### 3.18.15.204 SYST-231 RCRON: Action failed

Cause: RCRON command could not be executed. This is caused by either an incorrect crontab file or by the corresponding module not being loaded on the controller.

Remedy: Check md:crontab.dg for errors.

<!-- PDF page 1803 -->

### 3.18.15.205 SYST-232 RCRON: Tick missed

Cause: RCRON was prevented from running on time.

Remedy: Too many RCRON jobs might be executing. Check md:crontab.dg and remove non-critical entries.

### 3.18.15.206 SYST-233 RCRON: No response from MAIN

Cause: A job on the MAIN processor was not completed on time.

Remedy: Too many RCRON jobs might be executing on MAIN. Check md:crontab.dg and remove non-critical entries.

### 3.18.15.207 SYST-239 Auto Software Update failed

Cause: Last software update failed.

Remedy: Restore backup in MC:00TEMP or UD1:00TEMP and retry the software update.

### 3.18.15.208 SYST-242 Invalid RPS code

Cause: The RPS code is invalid BCD in BCD mode.

Remedy: Check the status of RPS1, RPS2, ... RPS128.

### 3.18.15.209 SYST-243 RPS failed(%s)

Cause: Please refer to the cause code.

Typical case is the program does not exist.

Remedy: Refer the cause code. Typically, the program does not exist.

### 3.18.15.210 SYST-244 Auto mode is required

Cause: This operation requires Auto mode.

Remedy: Change the mode switch to Auto.

<!-- PDF page 1804 -->

# **3.18.15.211 SYST-245 Local mode is required**

**Cause:** This operation requires Local mode.

**Remedy:** Change the mode to Local.

# **3.18.15.212 SYST-246 Teach mode is required**

**Cause:** This operation requires Teach mode.

**Remedy:** Change the mode to Teach.

# **3.18.15.213 SYST-247 Master ON is required**

**Cause:** This operation requires a Master ON situation.

**Remedy:** Ensure that the Master ON situation exists.

**Cause:** This operation requires no alarm situation.

**Remedy:** Clear the alarm situation.

# **3.18.15.215 SYST-249 No system ready input**

**Cause:** This operation requires the System Ready input.

**Remedy:** Check the status of the System Ready input.

# **3.18.15.216 SYST-250 No robot ready input**

**Cause:** This operation requires the Robot Ready input.

**Remedy:** Check the status of the Robot Ready input.

# **3.18.15.217 SYST-251 No teach plug ON input**

**Cause:** This operation requires the Teach Plug ON input.

**Remedy:** Check the status of the Teach Plug ON input.

<!-- PDF page 1805 -->

### 3.18.15.218 SYST-252 Teach plug ON input

Cause: This operation requires no Teach Plug ON input.

Remedy: Check the status of the Teach Plug ON input.

### 3.18.15.219 SYST-253 No safe stop input

Cause: This operation requires the Safe Stop input.

Remedy: Check the status of the Safe Stop input.

### 3.18.15.220 SYST-254 Safe stop input

Cause: This operation requires no Safe Stop input.

Remedy: Check the status of the Safe Stop input.

### 3.18.15.221 SYST-255 No Teach OK input

Cause: This operation requires the Teach OK input.

Remedy: Check the status of the Teach OK input.

### 3.18.15.222 SYST-256 Servo OFF input

Cause: This operation requires the Servo OFF input.

Remedy: Check the status of the Servo OFF input.

### 3.18.15.223 SYST-257 No Ext. Hold Relase input

Cause: This operation requires the External Hold Release input.

Remedy: Check the status of the External Hold Release input.

### 3.18.15.224 SYST-258 Operator panel hold

Cause: This operation requires that the HOLD/RUN switch on the Panel is set to RUN.

Remedy: Check the status of the HOLD/RUN switch on the Panel.

<!-- PDF page 1806 -->

### 3.18.15.225 SYST-259 UI signals are disabled

Cause: This operation requires that UI signals are enabled.

Remedy: Check the setting of 'Enable UI signals in the system config menu.

### 3.18.15.226 SYST-266 Please cycle power

Cause: Robot controller power must be cycled.

Remedy: Cycle power manually.

### 3.18.15.227 SYST-267 System is being initialized

Cause: System initialization is not finished.

Remedy: Wait a moment for system to be initialized.

### 3.18.15.228 SYST-268 Resume program(%s) execution

Cause: The program cannot be selected by PNSTROBE pulse signal while resume program is being executed.

Remedy:

1. Do not input the PNSTROBE pulse signal while resume program is being executed. (
2. Input the PNSTROBE pulse signal after ending the resume program(program name) when you input the PNSTROBE pulse signal.

### 3.18.15.229 SYST-269 FFR sequence(%s) execution

Cause: The program cannot be selected by the PNSTROBE pulse signal while fast fault recovery sequence is being executed.

Remedy:

1. Do not input the PNSTROBE pulse signal while fast fault recovery sequence is being executed.
2. Input the PNSTROBE pulse signal after ending the FFR sequence(program name) when you input the PNSTROBE pulse signal.

<!-- PDF page 1807 -->

### 3.18.15.230 SYST-270 Ref. Position maximum exceeded

Cause: Reference Positions were enabled beyond the maximum number.

Remedy: Do not exceed maximum enabled Reference Positions.

### 3.18.15.231 SYST-271 Lack of MC for saving

Cause: Lack of enough space in MC for saving diagnostic log data.

Remedy: Keep enough space in MC to save data.

### 3.18.15.232 SYST-272 Lack of USB for saving

Cause: Lack of enough space in USB for saving diagnostic log data.

Remedy: Keep enough space in USB to save data.

### 3.18.15.233 SYST-277 BMON update failed

Cause: An automatic update of BMON failed for some reason.

Remedy: Refer to the error cause code in the Alarm history for a specific reason. Manually update BMON at Configuration start according to the instruction in the Software Installation Manual.

### 3.18.15.234 SYST-278 DCS File is lost

Cause: By power failure, safety parameter file is lost.

Remedy: Please apply, verify and cycle power

### 3.18.15.235 SYST-279 SCB memory allocation failed

Cause: SCB memory allocation failed.

Remedy: Please change value of $TSCFG.$SIZE smaller and cycle power.

### 3.18.15.236 SYST-280 Operating panel is Teach mode[P]

Cause: This error happens only when using M-TP(J897). Operating panel is Teaching mode.

<!-- PDF page 1808 -->

Remedy: When using M-TP, set operation panel to Auto mode.

### 3.18.15.237 SYST-281 Teaching mode input is ON[P]

Cause: This error happens only when using M-TP(J897). When changing to Auto mode, Teach mode input is ON.

Remedy: When changing to Auto mode, set Teaching mode input to OFF.

### 3.18.15.238 SYST-282 Auto mode input is ON[P]

Cause: This error happens only when using M-TP(J897). When changing to Teach mode, Auto mode input is ON.

Remedy: When changing to Teaching mode, set Auto mode input to OFF.

### 3.18.15.239 SYST-287 Not enough memory to increase frames

Cause: There is not enough memory to support the number of requested frames.

Remedy: $SCR.$MAXNUMUFRAM and $SCR.$MAXNUMUTOOL have been reset to the number of frames that were able to be configured. However, this is an indicator that controller memory is at a critically low state. A review of option content should be made and controller memory increased if required.

### 3.18.15.240 SYST-288 Failed to write DCS parameter(0x%x)

Cause: Write of DCS parameter failed.

Remedy: Wait a moment and try again.

### 3.18.15.241 SYST-289 Cannot apply to DCS parameter(0x%x)

Cause:Cannot apply to DCS parameter.

Remedy: Wait a moment and try again.

### 3.18.15.242 SYST-290 Cycle power to use new DCS parameter

Cause:Apply and Verify of safety parameter completed. Cycle power is needed to use new safety parameter.

<!-- PDF page 1809 -->

Remedy: Please cycle power.

### 3.18.15.243 SYST-298 Trigonometric Function not installed

Cause: Trigonometric Function option is not installed.

Remedy: Buy and install Trigonometric Function option.

### 3.18.15.244 SYST-299 Robot Setup Assistance not installed

Cause: Robot Setup Assistance not installed.

Remedy: Buy and install the Robot Setup Assistance option.

### 3.18.15.245 SYST-300 System Design Tool not installed

Cause: System Design Tool option is not installed.

Remedy: Buy and install the System Design Tool option.

### 3.18.15.246 SYST-301 External mode select is not available

Cause: External mode select function (J569) is loaded, but External mode select is not available in this op panel.

Remedy: Delete the External mode select function option, or use the op panel that has no mode switch. (Paint) Verify Estop board jumper EE-6595-616-001 is securely in place.

### 3.18.15.247 SYST-302 Please power off

Cause: There has been a SYSTEM severity alarm. Cycling power is required to reset this alarm.

Remedy: Check the cause code in the alarm screen for this alarm and power OFF/ON to recover

### 3.18.15.248 SYST-303 Details sent to iRConnect

Cause: Additional details on the posted alarm have been sent to iRConnect.

Remedy: Check the alarm details on iRConnect.

<!-- PDF page 1810 -->

### 3.18.15.249 SYST-304 Safety I/O device is not available

Cause: Multi-arm and DCS Safety I/O device can not be used in this hardware.

Remedy: Please change main board to use Multi-arm or Safety I/O device.

### 3.18.15.250 SYST-305 System startup in progress

Cause: System startup is in progress.

Remedy: Press reset after system startup is completed.

### 3.18.15.251 SYST-306 User info hasn't been registered

Cause: User information has not been registered yet.

Remedy: Refer to the Customer registration screen of Status menu.

### 3.18.15.252 SYST-307 See customer register screen(STATUS)

Cause: User information has not been registered yet.

Remedy: Refer to the Customer registration screen of the Status menu.

### 3.18.15.253 SYST-308 DCS SHIFT+RESET requires T1 mode

Cause: Shift Reset is pressed in T2 or AUTO mode.

Remedy: Turn mode key to T1 mode and press Shift Reset.

### 3.18.15.254 SYST-309 Cycle power to apply axis SETUP

Cause: Controller power has not been cycled after applying axis SETUP.

Remedy: Cycle controller power to finish applying axis SETUP.

### 3.18.15.255 SYST-311 Shared TP: Multiple TP connection

Cause: Multiple Teach Pendants are connected in Shared TP group.

Remedy: Remove extra Teach Pendants from controllers in Shared TP group.

<!-- PDF page 1811 -->

### 3.18.15.256 SYST-312 Shared TP: FL-net is disabled

Cause: Teach Pendant can not log in to the controller, because Safety Function by FL-net is disabled.

Remedy: Change setting of Safety Function by FL-net to ENABLE. Press MENU to reconnect to the local robot.

### 3.18.15.257 SYST-313 Shared TP: Shared TP is disabled

Cause: Teach Pendant cannot log in to the controller, because Shared Teach Pendant is disabled.

Remedy: Change the DCS setting of Shared Teach Pendant function to ENABLE. Press MENU to reconnect to the local robot.

### 3.18.15.258 SYST-314 Shared TP: shared group config error

Cause: Teach Pendant cannot log in to the controller, because this controller is not included in the Shared Teach Pendant group.

Remedy: Check setting of Shared Teach Pendant function. Press MENU to reconnect to the local robot.

### 3.18.15.259 SYST-315 Shared TP: bypassed robot

Cause: Teach Pendant can not log in to the controller because this robot is bypassed.

Remedy: Change bypass setting to OFF. Press MENU to reconnect to the local robot.

### 3.18.15.260 SYST-316 Applying axis SETUP

Cause: Applying axis SETUP has not finished yet.

Remedy: Wait for a while, and try the operation again. Turn mode key to T1 mode and press Shift Reset.

### 3.18.15.261 SYST-317 Disconnect TP in AUTO mode

Cause: TP DISCONNECT menu is selected in AUTO mode.

Remedy: Change mode AUTO to disconnect TP.

<!-- PDF page 1812 -->

# **3.18.15.262 SYST-318 Need Hot Swap option**

**Cause:** This menu cannot be used on this system.

**Remedy:** To use TP DISCONNEDT, special hardware and Hot swap option (J647) are needed.

# **3.18.15.263 SYST-319 Program resumed automatically**

**Cause:** Program is resumed automatically by Auto resume function of Collaborative Robot.

**Remedy:** None.

# **3.18.15.264 SYST-320 Contact force exceeds limit %x,%x**

**Cause:** Program is paused because the external force acting on Collaborative Robot is exceeds force limit.

**Remedy:** Clear the external force to the robot, confirm the safety, and execute the program. If the auto resume function is enabled, the program will be resumed automatically.

# **3.18.15.265 SYST-321 Contact force is not released**

**Cause:** A program is executed even if the intensity of the external force acting on Collaborative Robot is still high

**Remedy:** Clear the external force to the robot, confirm the safety, and execute the program.

# **3.18.15.266 SYST-326 Need to confirm payload**

**Cause:** Payload confirmation operation of Collaborative Robot has not been performed after power on.

**Remedy:** Payload confirmation operation is necessary after power on. Refer to the Operation After Power On section of the “Collaborative Robot Function OPERATOR’S MANUAL.”

# **3.18.15.267 SYST-327 Inappropriate regular test program**

**Cause:** Checking program for Collaborative Robot has a problem.

**Remedy:** Verify that each posture of the robot in the checking program must have a distance from each other. Verify that the number of the positions of the checking program is less than 30. Refer to the Periodical Check section of the “Collaborative Robot Function OPERATOR’S MANUAL.”

<!-- PDF page 1813 -->

### 3.18.15.294 SYST-358 Payload change distance disabled

Cause: On collaborative robot, payload number is cahnged on payload change distance disabled.

Remedy: Enable payload change distance or disable the contact stop function

### 3.18.15.295 SYST-359 Collaborative speed limit (Elbow)

Cause: Elbow speed exceeds safety limit on collaborative robot

Remedy: None.

### 3.18.15.296 SYST-360 Please cycle power

Cause: The operation requires a cycle power or the controller cannot cycle power automatically.

Remedy: Please cycle power. You may need to manually turn off and on the controller.

### 3.18.15.297 SYST-361 Controller is cycling power

Cause: The controller is cycling power.

Remedy: Please reconnect this screen after the controller restarts.

### 3.18.15.298 SYST-362 Payload Comp is disabled

Cause: Payload Comp Karel is called in Payload Comp disabled

Remedy: Don't call Payload Comp Karel. Or disable Alarm.

### 3.18.15.299 SYST-363 Sensor detection accuracy may be degraded

Cause: Sensor detection accuracy may be degraded

Remedy: None.

### 3.18.15.300 SYST-364 Jog is disabled during Manual Guided Teaching.

Cause: Jog is disabled during Manual Guided Teaching.

Remedy: None.

<!-- PDF page 1818 -->

### 3.18.15.301 SYST-365 Payload is changed during Manual Guided Teaching

Cause: Payload is changed during Manual Guided Teaching

Remedy: None.

### 3.18.15.302 SYST-366 Speed Limit for Manual Guided Teaching

Cause: Speed Limit for Manual Guided Teaching.

Remedy: Stop lead through once.

### 3.18.15.303 SYST-367 Contact force limit for Manual Guided teaching

Cause: Contact force exceeds limit to start Manual Guided Teaching

Remedy: Remove the couse of contact force

### 3.18.15.304 SYST-368 Paused during Manual Guided teaching
